items.title: 貿聯-KY結盟ams OSRAM 布局AI資料中心光學互連技術
items.title_en: MouLian-KY Partners with ams OSRAM to Deploy AI Data Center Optical Interconnect Technology
paras: 連接線束大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)今(21)日宣布，與創新光學與感測器解決方案領導廠商 ams OSRAM 建立生態系策略合作夥伴關係，共同開發適用於 AI 縱向擴展（scale-up）運算架構的次世代光學互連解決方案。
貿聯表示，將發揮在光纖陣列組裝、光學封裝、光學測試及大規模量產的核心優勢，與 ams OSRAM 攜手於即將登場的歐洲光通訊展（ECOC 2026），展示採用「寬而慢」（wide-and-slow，多通道並行、低速率傳輸）架構的光學互連技術，實現低功耗與低延遲（low-power, low-latency）。
隨著AI 縱向擴展運算規模持續擴大，迫切需要能同時兼顧功耗、延遲、高密度與高可靠度的互連解決方案，為了突破此技術瓶頸，雙方推出的創新光學架構直接瞄準這些關鍵痛點。
不同於傳統硬將龐大資料擠進少數複雜且耗電的高速通道，新架構將資料分散至大量平並行、中低速的通道傳輸，不僅大幅延長傳輸距離、實現超低延遲，更能兼顧成本與效能。
在西班牙舉辦的 ECOC 2026 展覽期間，貿聯與 ams OSRAM將公開發表連接器化多芯光纖解決方案（connectorized multi-core fiber solution），本次展示的實機系統採用波長 850 奈米 的二維可定址微型垂直共振腔面射型雷射（microVCSEL）陣列，並搭配貿聯專用的光纖對光纖（fiber-to-fiber）連接器與高精密光學封裝。
paras_en: MouLian-KY (3665-TW), a major connector manufacturer, announced today (the 21st) that it has formed an ecosystem strategic partnership with innovative optics and sensor solutions leader ams OSRAM to jointly develop next‑generation optical interconnect solutions for AI scale‑up computing architectures.

MouLian said it will leverage its core strengths in fiber array assembly, optical packaging, optical testing and high‑volume manufacturing, and together with ams OSRAM will showcase at the upcoming European Conference on Optical Communications (ECOC 2026) an optical interconnect technology that uses a “wide‑and‑slow” (multi‑channel parallel, low‑rate) architecture to achieve low power consumption and low latency.

As AI scale‑up computing workloads continue to grow, there is an urgent need for interconnect solutions that simultaneously address power, latency, high density and high reliability. To break this technical bottleneck, the two companies are introducing an innovative optical architecture that directly targets these critical pain points.

Unlike the traditional approach of cramming massive data into a few complex, power‑hungry high‑speed channels, the new architecture distributes data across a large number of parallel, mid‑to‑low‑speed channels, greatly extending transmission distance, achieving ultra‑low latency, and balancing cost with performance.

During the ECOC 2026 exhibition in Spain, MouLian and ams OSRAM will publicly unveil a connectorized multi‑core fiber solution. The demo system uses a 2‑D addressable micro‑VCSEL array operating at an 850‑nm wavelength, combined with MouLian’s proprietary fiber‑to‑fiber connectors and high‑precision optical packaging.

items.title: 升息難擋資金熱情！全球股票ETF單周吸金470億美元 台股反遭提款5.8億美元
items.title_en: Rising Rates Can't Dampen Investor Enthusiasm! Global Stock ETFs Pull in $47 B in One Week, Taiwan Stocks Lose $580 M
paras: 美日兩大央行同步採取升息動作，聯準會睽違3年再度啟動升息且政策態度偏鷹，日本央行亦同步升息，儘管市場一度消化Anthropic執行長呼籲全球放慢AI模型開發速度等疑慮，科技類股仍展現強韌走勢。資金面顯示，近1周整體股票型ETF持續獲得高達470.75億美元的大額資金淨流入，並以美國市場淨流入378.16億美元為最大宗。反觀亞股遭外資提款，賣壓沈重，南韓股市慘遭外資淨賣超64.36億美元居冠，台股亦遭賣超5.80億美元。
富蘭克林證券投顧分析，聯準會啟動升息但政策前景已趨於明朗，預估本波屬於溫和升息，美國公債殖利率攀升反映高成長、高資本需求與高實質利率的結果。在目前缺乏推動股市再創新高的催化劑下，預期股市將呈現區間震盪。若美國與伊朗局勢趨緩帶動油價回落，可降低能源成本外溢效應與地緣政治風險，成為短期上漲動力。整體而言，風險性資產穩中走升趨勢不變，建議投資人均衡配置不同風格與產業。

就資金流向觀察，股票型ETF近1周全球狂吸470.75億美元。區域方面，美股ETF獲378.16億美元大幅挹注，歐洲與拉美市場亦分別獲3.95億與2.51億美元淨流入；反觀亞洲市場遭遇0.98億美元淨流出，其中中國市場淨流出3.83億美元，日本市場淨流出0.22億美元。產業部分，近1周淨流入前三大產業分別為主題型（33.47億美元）、科技（31.37億美元）與非核心消費（13.28億美元）；淨流出前三大則為金融（32.50億美元）、保健（13.29億美元）與原物料（5.16億美元）。
亞股外資動向方面，賣壓依然延續，南韓股市慘遭外資淨賣超64.36億美元居冠，台股亦遭賣超5.80億美元，印度與印尼分別遭賣超7.15億與1.66億美元；僅越南與馬來西亞股市獲得1.03億及0.31億美元逆勢淨買超。
固定收益型ETF方面，過去1周整體獲得180.62億美元淨流入，美債吸引99.13億美元居首，亞洲與歐洲債市分別獲25.87億與6.99億美元進駐。若依債券品質劃分，投資等級債獲101.35億美元淨流入，非投資等級債亦獲得6.51億美元淨流入。
富蘭克林坦伯頓美國機會基金經理人葛蘭‧包爾指出，美國經濟韌性十足且衰退風險極低，企業獲利正加速成長，且成長不侷限於科技業，通訊服務、消費耐久財與金融等產業均保持健康成長。富蘭克林坦伯頓新興國家基金經理人伽坦·賽加爾則分析，亞洲新興市場企業在全球半導體與AI供應鏈中扮演關鍵角色，將持續受惠於AI基礎建設的資本支出循環。
投資布局上，專家建議以AI生態系擴張為主軸，搭配生技、美股與日股基金，並納入約1成黃金及貴金屬產業型基金以提高投組報酬並分散風險。債券方面則建議以美國或全球平衡型基金為核心，穩健參與高息題材。
paras_en: The U.S. and Japan central banks simultaneously raised rates, with the Fed restarting hikes after a three‑year pause and adopting a more hawkish stance, while the Bank of Japan also tightened. Despite market concerns over Anthropic CEO’s call to slow global AI model development, tech stocks remained resilient. In the past week, equity ETFs attracted a massive net inflow of $47.075 billion, led by the U.S. market with a net $37.816 billion inflow. In contrast, Asian equities saw heavy foreign‑outflows, with South Korea bearing the brunt at a net sell‑off of $6.436 billion, and Taiwan also net‑selling $580 million.

Franklin Securities’ research notes that although the Fed has begun raising rates, the policy outlook is becoming clearer and this cycle is likely to be a moderate tightening. Rising U.S. Treasury yields reflect high growth, capital demand and real rates. With no clear catalyst to push stocks to new highs, the market is expected to trade in a range. If U.S.–Iran tensions ease and oil prices fall, lower energy‑cost spillovers and reduced geopolitical risk could provide short‑term upside. Overall, risk assets are still on an upward trend, and investors are advised to maintain a balanced mix of styles and sectors.

Looking at fund flows, global equity ETFs sucked in $47.075 billion over the past week. Regionally, U.S. equity ETFs received a huge $37.816 billion, while Europe and Latin America saw net inflows of $395 million and $251 million respectively. Asia, however, experienced a net outflow of $98 million, with China losing $383 million and Japan $22 million. By industry, the top three net‑inflow sectors were thematic ($3.347 billion), technology ($3.137 billion) and non‑core consumer ($1.328 billion); the biggest net outflows were from financials ($3.250 billion), healthcare ($1.329 billion) and materials ($516 million).

Foreign investors continued to sell Asian equities. South Korea led with a net sell‑off of $6.436 billion, followed by Taiwan’s $580 million net outflow, India’s $715 million and Indonesia’s $166 million. Only Vietnam and Malaysia recorded net purchases of $103 million and $31 million respectively, bucking the trend.

Fixed‑income ETFs saw a net inflow of $18.062 billion over the past week, led by U.S. Treasuries which attracted $9.913 billion. Asian and European bond markets added $2.587 billion and $699 million respectively. By credit quality, investment‑grade bonds received a net $10.135 billion, while high‑yield (non‑investment‑grade) bonds saw a net inflow of $651 million.

Franklin Templeton’s U.S. Opportunity Fund manager Glen Bower said the U.S. economy is very resilient with recession risk extremely low, and corporate earnings are accelerating across sectors—not just tech but also communications services, durable consumer goods and financials, all showing healthy growth. Franklin Templeton’s Emerging Markets Fund manager Gatan Seagal added that Asian emerging‑market companies play a critical role in the global semiconductor and AI supply chain and will continue to benefit from AI infrastructure capital‑expenditure cycles.

Experts recommend building portfolios around the expanding AI ecosystem, complemented by biotech, U.S. and Japanese equity funds, and allocating about 10 % to gold and precious‑metal sector funds to boost returns and diversify risk. For bonds, they suggest focusing on U.S. or global balanced‑fund cores to participate prudently in high‑yield themes.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：權值股領軍強攻，47K站穩後直逼前高

台股今日呈現「開高震盪走高」格局，終場大漲538點、收在47,718點，成交量約8,202億元，指數續創近3個月新高，距離前波歷史高點48,218點僅約500點，短線多方氣勢明顯回溫。
今日盤面由台積電、聯發科、台達電等大型電子權值股領軍，電子零組件、半導體、PCB、封測等族群同步走強；台積電終場收2,480元、上漲20元，台達電及聯發科亦明顯走高。
OTC則呈現「量縮價穩」格局，收412.57點、微跌0.11點，仍守穩10日線、月線及季線，顯示資金雖集中大型權值股，但中小型股多頭結構尚未遭到破壞。
目前指數已進入前高反壓區，短線若出現量縮震盪或獲利了結，反而屬高檔換手的一環；後續觀察重點在於48K能否突破，以及成交量能否重新回到兆元以上。


二、盤勢展望：基本面接棒，第四季行情仍具題材

聯準會9月會議等近期重大事件告一段落，市場焦點逐步從利率與總經不確定性，重新轉向企業營收、AI需求與第四季旺季基本面。
本周適逢中秋連假前夕，加上國際地緣政治及油價變化仍可能造成短線波動，因此量能縮減並不意外；反而在指數維持高檔、均線結構偏多的情況下，短線宜留意震盪換手。
公開市場分析指出，近十年中秋節後20個交易日台股上漲機率約60%，後60個交易日約90%，平均漲幅約4.8%；但此屬歷史統計，並非今年行情的保證，仍須搭配量價與基本面觀察。
目前市場部分法人預估台積電(2330-TW)9月營收有機會挑戰5,200億元，若後續營收及AI供應鏈財報持續驗證需求強度，市場焦點有機會進一步回到基本面。


三、產業主軸：AI、先進封裝、CPO仍是核心

AI伺服器與半導體仍是目前台股最重要的基本面主軸。AI算力持續提升，帶動先進製程、先進封裝、高速傳輸、散熱、PCB、測試及光通訊等供應鏈需求。
矽光子與CPO的重要性持續提高。台積電已表示，AI資料中心高速成長正推升光通訊需求，矽光子有望成為重要平台；今年光收發模組需求預期仍維持高速成長，CPO也持續朝量產方向發展。
台積電年度OIP生態系論壇北美場將於9月23日舉行，官方議程涵蓋AI、先進製程等生態系議題；產業關注焦點包括A14、A16、3D封裝與光學互連等技術。
因此，後續可持續觀察先進封裝、CPO、矽光子、高速傳輸、測試設備、PCB與ASIC等族群，尤其是具有實際訂單、營收成長與獲利改善的公司。


四、操作策略：選股重於選市，低接不追高

目前台股已接近48K前高，指數空間與個股表現將逐漸出現差異，操作重心宜從「追指數」轉向選產業、選公司、選基本面。
權值股維持強勢有助指數穩定，但中小型股則可留意低基期轉機股、AI供應鏈及2027年訂單能見度較高的公司。
面對高檔行情，仍應遵守「低接不追高、汰弱留強、嚴控資金配置」原則；若量能未同步放大，短線急漲個股更應避免過度追價。
整體而言，目前市場仍處於多方控盤、高檔震盪、基本面接棒的階段；後續真正關鍵將是48K前高突破力道、成交量變化，以及AI供應鏈營收與獲利能否持續驗證。
今日強勢股除了ASIC創意(3443-TW)、連接線宏致(3665-TW)、網印倉和(6538-TW)、不鏽鋼管配件大甲(2221-TW)、特化和益(1709-TW)…等續創新高外，包括網通聯傑(3094-TW)、豪勉(6218-TW)、達發(6526-TW)、明泰(3380-TW)、建漢(3062-TW)、CPO轉機股友達(2409-TW)、聯光通(4903-TW)、明基材(8215-TW)、LED轉機股宏齊(6168-TW)、光鋐(4956-TW)、電子元件詮欣(6205-TW)、連接器貿聯(3665-TW)、設備類股公準(3178-TW)、倚強科(3219-TW)、易發(6425-TW)、高僑(6234-TW)、蔚華電(3055-TW)、惠特(6706-TW)、封測類股華東(8110-TW)、南茂(8150-TW)…等低基期轉機股輪動接棒大漲上來，雖然對於某些漲幅已大的個股，並不建議過度做追價，不過，只要多方控盤不變，逢低仍是值得留意。


一句話總結：目前台股已進入「47K站穩、48K攻防、基本面接棒」的關鍵階段；短線雖可能受連假、油價與國際局勢干擾而震盪，但AI需求、先進製程、先進封裝與CPO等主流產業仍提供基本面支撐，因此操作上更適合選股重於選市、低接不追高。

paras_en: 1. Market structure: heavyweight stocks lead a strong attack, holding steady at 47K and eyeing the previous high.

2. Taiwan stocks today showed a "high open, volatile rise" pattern, closing up 538 points at 47,718, with a turnover of about NT$8,202 billion. The index continued to set a near‑three‑month high, only about 500 points away from the previous historic peak of 48,218, indicating a clear short‑term bullish momentum. The session was led by large‑cap electronics giants such as TSMC, MediaTek and Delta Electronics, with electronic components, semiconductors, PCB and test‑packaging groups all advancing together; TSMC closed at NT$2,480, up NT$20, while Delta and MediaTek also rose sharply. The OTC market showed a "lower volume, stable price" pattern, closing at 412.57 points, down 0.11 points, still holding the 10‑day, monthly and quarterly lines, indicating that although capital is concentrated in large caps, the bullish structure of mid‑ and small‑cap stocks has not been broken. The index is now in the resistance zone of the previous high; a short‑term pull‑back with reduced volume or profit‑taking would simply be a high‑level turnover. The key watch points are whether the 48K level can be broken and whether turnover can climb back above the trillion‑NTD mark.

3. Market outlook: fundamentals take over, Q4 still has themes. The Fed’s September meeting and other recent major events have concluded, shifting market focus from interest‑rate and macro uncertainty back to corporate earnings, AI demand and the Q4 seasonal fundamentals. This week falls just before the Mid‑Autumn holiday, and ongoing geopolitical tensions and oil‑price swings may cause short‑term volatility, so reduced volume is not surprising; with the index staying high and moving‑average structure still bullish, short‑term traders should watch for oscillating turnover. Public market analysis notes that in the past ten years, the Taiwan market has a roughly 60% chance of rising in the first 20 trading days after the Mid‑Autumn break and about 90% in the following 60 days, with an average gain of 4.8%; however, this is historical statistics and not a guarantee for this year, so volume‑price and fundamentals must be considered together. Some institutions now estimate TSMC (2330‑TW) could challenge NT$520 billion in September revenue; if subsequent earnings and AI‑supply‑chain reports continue to confirm strong demand, market focus may shift further back to fundamentals.

4. Industry focus: AI, advanced packaging, CPO remain core. AI servers and semiconductors are still the most important fundamentals for Taiwan stocks. Rising AI compute power drives demand across advanced processes, advanced packaging, high‑speed transmission, cooling, PCB, testing and optical‑communication supply chains. The importance of silicon photonics and CPO keeps growing. TSMC has said that rapid growth of AI data‑center traffic is boosting optical‑communication demand, and silicon photonics could become a key platform; this year’s demand for optical transceiver modules is expected to stay fast‑growing, and CPO continues moving toward mass production. TSMC’s annual OIP ecosystem forum in North America will be held on September 23, covering AI, advanced processes and other ecosystem topics; industry attention includes technologies such as A14, A16, 3D packaging and optical interconnects. Therefore, investors can keep watching groups like advanced packaging, CPO, silicon photonics, high‑speed transmission, test equipment, PCB and ASICs, especially companies with real orders, revenue growth and profit improvement.

5. Trading strategy: pick stocks over picking the market, buy low, avoid chasing highs. The Taiwan market is now near the 48K previous high, and the gap between index movement and individual stocks will widen; the focus should shift from "chasing the index" to selecting industries, companies and fundamentals. Heavyweights staying strong helps index stability, but mid‑ and small‑caps can be watched for low‑base turnaround stocks, AI‑supply‑chain firms and companies with visible 2027 order pipelines. （按讚訂閱打開小鈴鐺）
再來看一下今天的台股!
加權指數今日開高走高，終場上漲538.09點，收在47718.84，成交量8202.16億。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資買超203.75億元，投信買超39.32億元，自營商買超227.29億元，三大法人合計買超470.37億元，其中，外資連買三日共買超1195.75億元、自營商連買三日共買超486.09億元，投信連買四日共買超343.82億元。

美股上週五漲跌互見，AI題材持續發揮支撐作用，那斯達克指數上漲0.39%，標普500指數上漲0.17%，費城半導體指數更大漲2.78%，科技股買氣明顯回溫，盤面上，(NVDA-US)輝達，上漲1.34%，(MU-US)美光，漲3.92%，(AMAT-US)應用材料，大漲6.51%，AI與半導體族群重新成為市場焦點，此外，比特幣價格反彈，(COIN-US)Coinbase，股價更暴漲11.66%，帶動加密貨幣相關資產同步走強，國際消息方面，市場預期沙烏地阿拉伯可能在數日內恢復東西向輸油管線約一半運能，有助緩解原油供應中斷疑慮，川普本週也表示，希望戰爭已接近尾聲，並稱伊朗非常希望達成協議，地緣政治風險暫未進一步擴大，AI產業方面，Anthropic已告知投資人，預計今年底前取得約5GW運算能力，顯示大型AI模型對算力需求持續攀升，本週市場焦點則轉向Fed官員談話及川習會，尤其美中AI發展競賽、半導體管制、關稅與稀土供應等議題，均可能牽動科技股評價。
今日台股無懼海外地緣政治雜音，加權指數今日開高走高，帶動大盤盤中最高來到47,750.98點，終場上漲538.09點，收在47718.84，成交量8202.16億，距離48,000點整數關卡僅一步之遙，台股今日雖然量能縮小，主要在於中秋長假將至，不過依舊強勢再創新高，加上三大法人同步買超之下，上週五+今日的買超已超過千億元以上，挹注資金活水，加上台積電的OIP論壇即將登場下，
將帶動相關的先進封裝、半導體、CPO股發動；整體而言，雖然俄烏戰事、中東衝突及油價仍是市場風險來源，但目前亞洲股市並未出現全面避險，資金反而重新聚焦科技與AI，後續觀察重點仍在成交量能能否維持，以及電子權值股多頭氣勢是否延續，族群方面則可留意記憶體、半導體設備、矽光子、ASIC、伺服器及散熱等AI供應鏈，操作上維持盤勢震盪偏多、選股不選市的思維，在量能維持高檔的情況下，大盤短線仍以多方架構為主。

權值股方面，(2330-TW)台積電，上漲0.81%，收在2480元，8月營收達5,150億元，月增10%、年增53%，7、8月累計營收達9,820億元，約占第3季財測中值68%，若9月延續近年AI需求帶動的營收季節性，第3季營收可望略高於財測與市場共識，隨Agentic AI工作負載增加，CPU需求成為新成長動能，法人預估2027年CPU營收可達數百億美元，資本支出也將持續擴大，反映N3、N5、N7先進製程擴產需求，AI伺服器與邊緣AI長期需求仍具支撐，基本面維持成長格局；

(2317-TW)鴻海，下跌0.20%，收在250元，AI基礎建設已成為公司最重要的結構性成長動能，客戶從大型雲端服務商延伸至AI模型業者、主權AI及企業市場，並由傳統伺服器製造進一步走向直接客戶與高階系統整合，隨Vera Rubin新一代AI平台升級，AI機櫃ASP有望較前代提升約60%至70%，同時機櫃產能由每週約1,000櫃提高至2,000櫃，ASIC業務雖目前占比低於GPU，但成長速度更快，預期明年占比持續提升，搭配台灣、美國、墨西哥及印度擴產，AI伺服器將成為鴻海中長期主要成長引擎；

(2454-TW)聯發科，上漲6.37%，收在5010元，NVIDIA宣布投資35億美元可轉債，雙方合作由AI資料中心、AI PC延伸至汽車與實體AI，聯發科並透過NVLink Fusion切入客製化AI ASIC市場，公司首款大型AI加速器ASIC預計2026年第4季量產，資料中心營收目標超過20億美元，未來可望受惠第二代客製化晶片需求，隨NVLink-C2C、NVHBM等技術合作深化，聯發科將從手機SoC業者逐步轉型為AI運算平台，透過ASIC、AI PC及車用AI三大方向擴大高階晶片布局，降低對手機市場景氣循環的依賴。

宏齊積極布局利基型市場，車用功率元件與無人機測距模組成為後續成長雙引擎，受惠穿戴裝置、感測器及COB顯示屏看板需求增溫，產品結構持續優化，毛利率可望逐步改善，車用功率元件涵蓋25至685伏規格，部分產品延伸至AI伺服器，目前已進入客戶驗證，預計明年第2季起貢獻營收，無人機測距模組已小量出貨，明年有望擴大訂單，整體營運聚焦高毛利、高附加價值應用，持續提升獲利體質。
2026.9.14股市期皇后領先預告(4956-TW)光鋐
LED晶粒廠光鋐，積極調整產品結構並跨足光通訊領域，公司加速布局車載、Micro LED、VCSEL、光電二極體等利基型產品，並透過製程改善與研發投入，提高高毛利產品比重，隨產品結構優化與光通訊布局逐步發酵，成為近期市場資金關注焦點。
2026.9.5股市期皇后領先預告(2409-TW)友達
友達，持續加速資產活化，今年已出售三座廠房，合計回收約347億元，下一步市場聚焦中科5代廠與7.5代廠，傳出台積電已展開訪廠，若交易成局，2027年有望挹注處分利益，友達同步加碼CPO與先進封裝布局，透過閒置產能變現、資金投入新事業，推動非顯示業務轉型。

items.title_en: Oil Prices Fall, Spot ETF Inflows and Short Squeeze Push Bitcoin Above $84,000
paras: 比特幣周一(21日)亞市午盤強勁上揚，一度觸及84,174美元至84,200美元高點，單日漲幅約2%至3.2%，創下本月新高。
此波漲勢帶動加密貨幣市場全面揚升，總市值回升至約2.66兆美元，主流代幣如 Monero 飆漲 13%，Dogecoin、XRP 及 Ethereum 等同步走高。
這波強漲之際，國際油價連續第四日回落，布蘭特原油因美伊地緣局勢出現緩和預期而下跌約2%，顯著改善市場風險偏好，美股期貨與加密資產同步獲得買盤支撐。
另一方面，美國比特幣現貨 ETF 單日吸引 4.33 億美元淨流入，其中富達 FBTC 單日流入 3.107 億美元，貝萊德 IBIT 吸引 1.084 億美元，整體現貨 ETF 總淨資產已達 1,025.3 億美元。
價格短線暴衝誘發大量強制平倉，據《coinglass》數據，過去24 小時內全網爆倉金額接近 6 億美元，其中空頭爆倉高達 5.05 億美元，進一步加劇行情向上衝高。
技術面上，比特幣周線收盤 45 周以來，首次重返 50 周均線，歷史上常被視為熊市觸底的訊號。此外，Strategy(MSTR-US)創辦人 Saylor 暗示將繼續加碼(總持倉已達 845,050 枚比特幣)，美國眾議院金融服務委員會通過推進「戰略比特幣儲備」法案。
展望後續，市場將密切關注本周至少 8 位聯準會官員的演說、PMI 數據及川習會等宏觀動向。
paras_en: Bitcoin surged strongly in the Asian session on Monday (the 21st), reaching a high of $84,174 to $84,200, with a single‑day gain of about 2% to 3.2%, setting a new high for the month.

The rally lifted the entire cryptocurrency market, with total market cap climbing back to roughly $2.66 trillion, and leading tokens such as Monero jumping 13%, while Dogecoin, XRP and Ethereum also moved higher.

At the same time, international oil prices fell for the fourth consecutive day; Brent crude slipped about 2% on expectations of easing U.S.–Iran geopolitical tensions, markedly improving market risk appetite and providing buying support to U.S. equity futures and crypto assets alike.

On the other hand, U.S. Bitcoin spot ETFs saw a net inflow of $433 million in a single day, with Fidelity’s FBTC attracting $310.7 million and BlackRock’s IBIT pulling in $108.4 million, bringing total net assets of spot ETFs to $102.53 billion.

The sharp short‑term price surge triggered massive forced liquidations; according to Coinglass data, nearly $600 million of positions were liquidated across the network in the past 24 hours, with short‑side liquidations alone reaching $505 million, further fueling the upward move.

Technically, Bitcoin’s weekly chart closed above the 50‑week moving average for the first time in 45 weeks, a level historically seen as a bear‑market bottom signal. In addition, MicroStrategy founder Saylor hinted at further buying (total holdings now at 845,050 BTC), and the U.S. House Financial Services Committee passed legislation to advance a “Strategic Bitcoin Reserve.”
Looking ahead, the market will watch closely for speeches by at least eight Federal Reserve officials this week, upcoming PMI data and macro developments such as the U.S.–China summit.

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 4.75%！兩年債突變得很吃香　利率期權顯示市場開始押Fed不會升太兇 但最大變數是「它」
items.title_en: 4.75%! Two‑Year Bonds Suddenly Hot – Rate Options Show Market Betting the Fed Won’t Hike Too Aggressively, Yet the Biggest Variable Is “It”
paras: 美國短天期公債近期出現一波「逆勢回補」行情，投資人重新加碼兩年期美債，不是因為看壞美國經濟，而是認為聯準會(Fed)重啟升息後，市場已把過多緊縮預期提前反映到短端直利率。一旦通膨改善、實際升息幅度低於目前定價，兩年期殖利率回落、債價就有修復空間。兩年期美債對Fed政策最敏感，自今年2月低點以來殖利率已上揚約140個基點。
Fed上周三(16日)決議升息1碼至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，12名FOMC委員全票通過，會後兩年期美債殖利率衝上約4.75%，創多年新高，期貨與利率交換市場計入未來一年再緊縮約數10個至80個基點，部分曲線定價甚至指向明年9月政策利率約4.68%。
WisdomTree投資策略主管Kevin Flanagan指出，兩年期美債殖利率明顯高於當前政策利率，代表短端可能「走得太遠」。若要在殖利率曲線上找過度調整的位置，短端最突出。這也是近期資金回流兩年債的核心：假設Fed終能壓低通膨，當前4.75%附近收益率可視為安全墊，即使後續仍升息，只要路徑沒有市場目前計價那麼鷹，債價就有資本利得。
另據《彭博資訊》報導，與擔保隔夜融資利率(SOFR)連動、可在利率下行獲利的選擇權買盤增加。SOFR與Fed政策預期高度相關，顯示部分資金押緊縮預期過度。
Allspring Global Investments固定收益首席策略師George Bory表示，在Fed主席華許於傑克森霍爾央行年會上強調重建物價穩定後已加碼債券，並把久期適度向中期延伸，因中短債對長期通膨、財政與期限溢價敏感度較低，但票面收益已處近年高位。
Barings多資產組合解決方案主管Trevor Slaven也說，當前短端直利率是「最易形成明確價值判斷」的區域。他以約4.75%兩年期殖利率對比交換市場所隱含2027年9月約4.68%政策利率，認為市場已計入額外三次升息，實際發生機率不高。對持有到期者，4.75%票息本身就是回報；對主動操作者，若通膨或終點利率低於預期，還有價差可賺。
然而，這筆交易不是無險。中東與俄烏情勢持續，能源價格若再飆，恐把整體通膨與收支預期推高，逼Fed升息升得比市場更猛。
美銀策略師已提醒必須防基準利率最終升至5%以上，華許在9月升息後稱此次只是移除部分「寬鬆成分」，市場解讀為貨幣政策尚未明顯扼制經濟活動。
Columbia Threadneedle投資組合經理Ed Al-Hussainy則說，最難的是判斷一年後終點利率，過往每輪升息市場都曾低估Fed最終幅度。油價便是變數，因美伊局勢緩和則原油回跌、通膨預期降，而中東供應中斷擴大，則能源再成推升利率的力量。
Fed最新點陣圖的中位數傾向今年再升一次、2027年維穩，但官員公開路徑仍落後於市場定價；兩年期美債殖利率已跑在聯邦基金區間上方，讓短債同時具「高票息」與「政策錯價回補」兩種屬性。這也解釋周二(22日)690億美元兩年債拍賣為何受矚，因為承銷利率與投標倍數若表現穩健，代表短端「過度升息定價」獲更多資金認可；若得標殖利率再上、需求偏軟，則說明市場仍相信華許會把抗通膨做到通膨趨勢明確回2%為止。
整體看，短端美債正出現罕見窗口：殖利率因激進緊縮預期大漲，卻吸引看好通膨受控、實際升息低於定價的資金。周二拍賣結果、SOFR選擇權與兩年期走勢，將成為未來數周觀察「市場是否過度鷹派」的最直接三個標的。
paras_en: U.S. short‑term Treasury bonds have recently experienced a wave of “contrarian buying back,” as investors increase exposure to two‑year Treasuries—not because they are pessimistic about the U.S. economy, but because they believe that after the Fed resumes rate hikes the market has already priced too much tightening into short‑end yields. If inflation eases and the actual rate‑hike magnitude ends up lower than current pricing, the two‑year yield should fall and bond prices have room to recover. The two‑year note is the most Fed‑sensitive segment, having risen about 140 basis points since its low in February this year.

The Fed on Wednesday (the 16th) voted to raise rates by one quarter‑point to a target range of 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023, with all 12 FOMC members voting in favor. After the decision, the two‑year Treasury yield spiked to roughly 4.75%, a multi‑year high, while futures and interest‑rate swap markets priced an additional 10‑80 basis points of tightening over the next year, and some curve pricing even implied a policy rate of about 4.68% by September 2025.

Kevin Flanagan, head of investment strategy at WisdomTree, noted that the two‑year yield is clearly above the current policy rate, suggesting the short end may have “run too far.” If one looks for an over‑adjusted spot on the yield curve, the short end stands out. This is the core reason for the recent flow back into two‑year bonds: assuming the Fed can eventually bring inflation down, the current ~4.75% yield can be seen as a safe cushion, and even if rates rise further, as long as the path isn’t as hawkish as the market currently prices, bond prices can generate capital gains.

Bloomberg reports that buying pressure on options linked to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR)—which profit from a decline in rates—has increased. SOFR is highly correlated with Fed policy expectations, indicating that some investors are over‑betting on tightening.

George Bory, chief fixed‑income strategist at Allspring Global Investments, said that after Fed Chair Waller emphasized rebuilding price stability at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium, he has added to bonds and modestly extended duration toward the medium term, because intermediate‑term debt is less sensitive to long‑term inflation, fiscal concerns, and term premia, while its coupon is already near multi‑year highs.

Trevor Slaven, head of multi‑asset solutions at Barings, added that the current short‑end yield is the “area where a clear value judgement is easiest.” Comparing the roughly 4.75% two‑year yield with the implied policy rate of about 4.68% for September 2027 from the swap market, he believes the market has priced in three additional hikes that are unlikely to materialize. For hold‑to‑maturity investors, the 4.75% coupon itself is the return; for active traders, there is still price spread to capture if inflation or the terminal rate ends up lower than expected.

However, the trade is not risk‑free. Ongoing tensions in the Middle East and the Russia‑Ukraine war could push energy prices higher again, raising overall inflation and balance‑sheet expectations and forcing the Fed to hike more aggressively than the market anticipates.

Bank of America strategists have warned that the benchmark rate could ultimately rise above 5%. After Waller’s September hike, he described the move as merely stripping away part of the “accommodative component,” which markets read as monetary policy still not strongly curbing economic activity.

Ed Al‑Hussainy, portfolio manager at Columbia Threadneedle, said the hardest part is forecasting the terminal rate a year out, noting that past tightening cycles have often seen the market underestimate the Fed’s final stance. Oil prices remain a wildcard: a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions could pull crude lower and ease inflation expectations, while a widening supply disruption in the Middle East could push energy‑driven rate pressures higher again.

The latest Fed dot‑plot median leans toward one more hike this year and a steady rate through 2027, but officials’ public guidance still lags market pricing. The two‑year yield now sits above the fed‑funds target range, giving short‑term debt both a “high coupon” and a “policy mis‑pricing correction” characteristic. This explains why the $69 billion two‑year auction on Tuesday the 22nd attracted attention: a solid underwriting rate and bid‑to‑cover ratio would signal that the market acknowledges the “over‑priced aggressive hike” on the short end, while a higher winning yield and soft demand would suggest investors still believe Waller will keep fighting inflation until the trend clearly returns to 2%.

Overall, the short‑end Treasury market is presenting a rare window: yields have surged on aggressive tightening expectations, yet they are drawing capital that believes inflation will be contained and that actual rate hikes will be lower than priced. The outcome of Tuesday’s auction, SOFR option activity, and the two‑year trend will be the three most direct gauges over the coming weeks of whether the market is being overly hawkish.

items.title: 貿聯-KY結盟ams OSRAM 布局AI資料中心光學互連技術
items.title_en: MouLian-KY Partners with ams OSRAM to Deploy AI Data Center Optical Interconnect Technology
paras: 連接線束大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)今(21)日宣布，與創新光學與感測器解決方案領導廠商 ams OSRAM 建立生態系策略合作夥伴關係，共同開發適用於 AI 縱向擴展（scale-up）運算架構的次世代光學互連解決方案。
貿聯表示，將發揮在光纖陣列組裝、光學封裝、光學測試及大規模量產的核心優勢，與 ams OSRAM 攜手於即將登場的歐洲光通訊展（ECOC 2026），展示採用「寬而慢」（wide-and-slow，多通道並行、低速率傳輸）架構的光學互連技術，實現低功耗與低延遲（low-power, low-latency）。
隨著AI 縱向擴展運算規模持續擴大，迫切需要能同時兼顧功耗、延遲、高密度與高可靠度的互連解決方案，為了突破此技術瓶頸，雙方推出的創新光學架構直接瞄準這些關鍵痛點。
不同於傳統硬將龐大資料擠進少數複雜且耗電的高速通道，新架構將資料分散至大量平並行、中低速的通道傳輸，不僅大幅延長傳輸距離、實現超低延遲，更能兼顧成本與效能。
在西班牙舉辦的 ECOC 2026 展覽期間，貿聯與 ams OSRAM將公開發表連接器化多芯光纖解決方案（connectorized multi-core fiber solution），本次展示的實機系統採用波長 850 奈米 的二維可定址微型垂直共振腔面射型雷射（microVCSEL）陣列，並搭配貿聯專用的光纖對光纖（fiber-to-fiber）連接器與高精密光學封裝。
paras_en: MouLian-KY (3665-TW), a major connector manufacturer, announced today (the 21st) that it has formed an ecosystem strategic partnership with innovative optics and sensor solutions leader ams OSRAM to jointly develop next‑generation optical interconnect solutions for AI scale‑up computing architectures.

MouLian said it will leverage its core strengths in fiber array assembly, optical packaging, optical testing and high‑volume manufacturing, and together with ams OSRAM will showcase at the upcoming European Conference on Optical Communications (ECOC 2026) an optical interconnect technology that uses a “wide‑and‑slow” (multi‑channel parallel, low‑rate) architecture to achieve low power consumption and low latency.

As AI scale‑up computing workloads continue to grow, there is an urgent need for interconnect solutions that simultaneously address power, latency, high density and high reliability. To break this technical bottleneck, the two companies are introducing an innovative optical architecture that directly targets these critical pain points.

Unlike the traditional approach of cramming massive data into a few complex, power‑hungry high‑speed channels, the new architecture distributes data across a large number of parallel, mid‑to‑low‑speed channels, greatly extending transmission distance, achieving ultra‑low latency, and balancing cost with performance.

During the ECOC 2026 exhibition in Spain, MouLian and ams OSRAM will publicly unveil a connectorized multi‑core fiber solution. The demo system uses a 2‑D addressable micro‑VCSEL array operating at an 850‑nm wavelength, combined with MouLian’s proprietary fiber‑to‑fiber connectors and high‑precision optical packaging.

二、盤勢展望：基本面接棒，第四季行情仍具題材

聯準會9月會議等近期重大事件告一段落，市場焦點逐步從利率與總經不確定性，重新轉向企業營收、AI需求與第四季旺季基本面。
本周適逢中秋連假前夕，加上國際地緣政治及油價變化仍可能造成短線波動，因此量能縮減並不意外；反而在指數維持高檔、均線結構偏多的情況下，短線宜留意震盪換手。

目前市場部分法人預估台積電(2330-TW)9月營收有機會挑戰5,200億元，若後續營收及AI供應鏈財報持續驗證需求強度，市場焦點有機會進一步回到基本面。


三、產業主軸：AI、先進封裝、CPO仍是核心

AI伺服器與半導體仍是目前台股最重要的基本面主軸。AI算力持續提升，帶動先進製程、先進封裝、高速傳輸、散熱、PCB、測試及光通訊等供應鏈需求。
矽光子與CPO的重要性持續提高。台積電已表示，AI資料中心高速成長正推升光通訊需求，矽光子有望成為重要平台；今年光收發模組需求預期仍維持高速成長，CPO也持續朝量產方向發展。
台積電年度OIP生態系論壇北美場將於9月23日舉行，官方議程涵蓋AI、先進製程等生態系議題；產業關注焦點包括A14、A16、3D封裝與光學互連等技術。
因此，後續可持續觀察先進封裝、CPO、矽光子、高速傳輸、測試設備、PCB與ASIC等族群，尤其是具有實際訂單、營收成長與獲利改善的公司。


四、操作策略：選股重於選市，低接不追高

目前台股已接近48K前高，指數空間與個股表現將逐漸出現差異，操作重心宜從「追指數」轉向選產業、選公司、選基本面。
權值股維持強勢有助指數穩定，但中小型股則可留意低基期轉機股、AI供應鏈及2027年訂單能見度較高的公司。
面對高檔行情，仍應遵守「低接不追高、汰弱留強、嚴控資金配置」原則；若量能未同步放大，短線急漲個股更應避免過度追價。
整體而言，目前市場仍處於多方控盤、高檔震盪、基本面接棒的階段；後續真正關鍵將是48K前高突破力道、成交量變化，以及AI供應鏈營收與獲利能否持續驗證。
今日強勢股除了ASIC創意(3443-TW)、連接線宏致(3665-TW)、網印倉和(6538-TW)、不鏽鋼管配件大甲(2221-TW)、特化和益(1709-TW)…等續創新高外，包括網通聯傑(3094-TW)、豪勉(6218-TW)、達發(6526-TW)、明泰(3380-TW)、建漢(3062-TW)、CPO轉機股友達(2409-TW)、聯光通(4903-TW)、明基材(8215-TW)、LED轉機股宏齊(6168-TW)、光鋐(4956-TW)、電子元件詮欣(6205-TW)、連接器貿聯(3665-TW)、設備類股公準(3178-TW)、倚強科(3219-TW)、易發(6425-TW)、高僑(6234-TW)、蔚華電(3055-TW)、惠特(6706-TW)、封測類股華東(8110-TW)、南茂(8150-TW)…等低基期轉機股輪動接棒大漲上來，雖然對於某些漲幅已大的個股，並不建議過度做追價，不過，只要多方控盤不變，逢低仍是值得留意。

paras: 台股再度以長紅K突破前高，市場信心回升，但是否足以確認新一波攻勢，仍要回到量價結構。前一個交易日已出現帶量突破，連續兩根紅K有利多方延續，只是今日成交量沒有同步放大，漲跌家數也未全面擴散，指數主要仍由台積電、聯發科、台達電等大型權值股帶動；櫃買指數相對溫和，更能反映中小型股尚未全面轉強。接近中秋長假，與其追著指數跑，不如觀察外資現貨是否續回流、期貨淨空單是否續減，以及新台幣能否轉強，這些才是後續資金行情能否延續的重要訊號。

外部環境同樣不能忽略。AI仍是全球資本支出的主戰場，中美都在加速投入資料中心與AI基礎建設，對台灣半導體、伺服器與電力供應鏈仍是長線支撐。真正需要留意的是債市，高檔的美國十年期公債殖利率會壓抑股票估值，但只要美債需求仍在、經濟維持韌性，就不必過度恐慌。對台股來說，更重要的是企業獲利接棒，若第三季獲利延續成長，搭配十月美股財報、十一月台股法說與財報題材，以及年底集團與法人作帳，第四季仍具備基本面與資金面的想像空間。

產業選擇上，方向已愈來愈清楚。晶圓代工、記憶體、封測、光通訊、半導體測試、IC設計與電源，都是持續追蹤的主軸。台積電受惠AI基礎建設資本支出擴張，可作為長線核心持股；聯發科兼具大型股與高成長特性，市場對未來獲利期待升高，更適合用中長線角度看待，而非只做短線價差。台達電、光寶科等電源股同樣受惠AI伺服器功率提升與資料中心電力需求。至於記憶體，不能只看一句「缺不缺貨」，仍要回到價格、供需與研究數據，才能判斷真正的循環位置。

操作上，最重要的不是猜中秋節前一定漲或一定跌，而是先把持股結構建立好。大型、低貝塔股票可放在核心部位，穩定參與趨勢；大型高貝塔或小型高貝塔股票則可作為衛星部位，爭取行情加速時的超額報酬，但前提是投資人必須承受更大的波動。風險與報酬本來就同時存在，不能一方面追求高報酬，一方面又無法接受短線震盪。若中秋節前出現回檔，反而可重新檢視基本面未變的強勢產業，分批站在買方。第四季真正要比的，不是誰最會猜指數，而是誰能提前卡位獲利成長、法人關注與資金作帳同時集中的主流族群。
升息不確定性落地後，資金重新回到成長股，而我們早就鎖定ASIC、記憶體、CPO、半導體檢測、散熱這幾條主線。今天行情一點火，手上的股票直接集體表態！

paras_en: Taiwan stocks again broke previous highs with a long bullish candle, reviving market confidence. Whether this confirms a new wave of advance still depends on volume‑price structure. The prior session saw a volume‑backed breakout and two consecutive red candles supporting the bulls, but today’s trading volume did not expand and the number of advancing‑declining stocks did not broaden. The index was still mainly driven by large‑cap names such as TSMC, MediaTek and Delta Electronics; the OTC index was relatively modest, reflecting that small‑ and mid‑cap stocks have not fully turned stronger. With the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, instead of merely chasing the index, watch whether foreign cash continues to flow back into spot markets, whether futures net short positions keep shrinking, and whether the New Taiwan dollar can strengthen—these are the key signals for the continuation of capital flows.

The external environment also matters. AI remains the main battlefield for global capital spending, with both the U.S. and China accelerating investments in data centers and AI infrastructure, providing long‑term support for Taiwan’s semiconductor, server and power‑supply chains. More attention should be paid to the bond market: the high U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield suppresses equity valuations, but as long as demand for U.S. Treasuries remains and the economy stays resilient, panic is unnecessary. For Taiwan equities, the crucial factor is corporate earnings succession. If Q3 earnings keep growing, combined with October U.S. earnings season, November Taiwan earnings releases and year‑end corporate accounting, Q4 still holds upside both fundamentally and in terms of capital inflows.

In terms of sector selection, the direction is becoming clearer. Wafer foundry, memory, packaging & testing, optical communications, semiconductor test, IC design and power supplies are the main themes to watch. TSMC benefits from expanding AI‑related capital expenditures and can serve as a long‑term core holding; MediaTek combines large‑cap stability with high growth potential, and rising profit expectations make it more suitable for a medium‑ to long‑term view rather than short‑term price swings. Power‑supply stocks such as Delta Electronics and Lextar are also helped by higher AI server power demand and data‑center electricity needs. As for memory, one cannot rely solely on the “shortage or not” narrative; price, supply‑demand balance and research data must be examined to pinpoint the true cycle position.

In practice, the most important thing is not to guess whether the market will rise or fall before the Mid‑Autumn holiday, but to first build a solid stock‑holding structure. Large‑cap, low‑beta stocks can form the core portfolio for stable trend participation; large‑cap high‑beta or small‑cap high‑beta stocks can serve as satellite positions to capture excess returns when the rally accelerates, provided investors can tolerate higher volatility. Risk and reward coexist; one cannot chase high returns while refusing short‑term swings. If a pull‑back occurs before the holiday, it offers a chance to re‑evaluate fundamentally strong sectors and add to positions in batches. In Q4, the real competition is not who can best predict the index, but who can pre‑position in the mainstream groups that attract profit growth, institutional focus and capital accounting simultaneously.

After the uncertainty around rate hikes settles, capital is flowing back into growth stocks, and we have already locked in the main themes of ASICs, memory, CPO, semiconductor testing and cooling. Today’s market ignited, and the stocks we hold all responded collectively!

items.title: 台新證強化投資防護網 攜手刑事警察局簽MOU
items.title_en: Taishin Securities Strengthens Investment Protection Network, Signs MOU with Criminal Police Bureau
paras: 數位金融服務快速發展，但詐騙手法也不斷演變，台新證券和台新期貨今(21)日與內政部警政署刑事警察局簽署反詐騙合作意向書(MOU)，從「事前預防、事中攔阻、事後協處」等面向深化合作，積極強化投資市場防護網。
台新證券董事長陳俊宏表示，面對日益猖獗且高度數位化的金融詐騙，單一機構的防護力量已不足以因應快速變化的犯罪手法，唯有結合政府執法專業和金融機構的風險控管能力，建立跨域聯防機制，才能提升整體防詐效能。
此次雙方的合作，將針對異常帳戶辨識、即時通報和資金攔阻等關鍵環節，建立更快速的聯繫跟應變機制，期望在第一時間從源頭阻斷詐騙金流，減少民眾損失。
據警政署165打詐儀錶板統計，投資詐騙長期是高財損詐騙類型之一，8月假投資詐騙造成的財損金額近11.2億元。詐騙集團透過假冒投資專家、虛偽投資平台和社群廣告等方式吸引民眾上鉤，再以高報酬、低風險等話術誘導加碼，凸顯提升民眾識詐意識和金融機構堵詐能力的重要性。
台新證表示，除積極配合政府及主管機關推動各項打詐政策，也持續強化內部反詐騙機制，並透過各項活動及防詐宣導，提升投資人對常見詐騙手法的辨識能力。
paras_en: Digital financial services are developing rapidly, but fraud tactics are constantly evolving. Today (the 21st), Taishin Securities and Taishin Futures signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on anti‑fraud cooperation with the Criminal Police Bureau of the Ministry of the Interior’s National Police Agency. The partnership will deepen cooperation in areas such as "pre‑vention, in‑process interception, and post‑incident coordination" to actively strengthen the protective net of the investment market.

Taishin Securities Chairman Chen Jun‑hong said that faced with increasingly rampant and highly digitalized financial fraud, the protective power of a single institution is no longer sufficient to cope with rapidly changing criminal methods. Only by combining government law‑enforcement expertise with the risk‑control capabilities of financial institutions to build a cross‑domain joint‑defense mechanism can overall anti‑fraud effectiveness be improved.

The cooperation will focus on key steps such as abnormal account identification, real‑time reporting and fund interception, establishing a faster communication and response mechanism. The goal is to block fraudulent money flows at the source in the first instance, thereby reducing losses to the public.

According to the National Police Agency’s “165 Anti‑Fraud Dashboard,” investment fraud has long been one of the highest‑loss fraud types. In August, fake investment scams caused financial losses of nearly NT$1.12 billion. Fraud groups lure victims by impersonating investment experts, using bogus platforms and social‑media ads, then persuade them to add more funds with promises of high returns and low risk, highlighting the importance of raising public fraud‑awareness and enhancing financial institutions’ fraud‑blocking capabilities.

Taishin Securities said that, in addition to actively cooperating with the government and regulators on anti‑fraud policies, it continues to strengthen its internal anti‑fraud mechanisms and, through various activities and fraud‑prevention outreach, improves investors’ ability to recognize common scam tactics.

items.title: 〈台幣〉風險情緒轉強 升值5分收31.758元
items.title_en: NTD risk sentiment turns strong, gains 0.05 and closes at 31.758
paras: 新台幣今(21)日全日維持偏強走勢，終場收在31.758元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.67億美元。
新台幣今日以31.79元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.716元，全日高低價差7.4分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元飆升超過1%，新台幣收升0.16%，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣升值0.05%上下，星元在平盤附近狹幅震盪，日元則逆勢貶近0.2%，美元指數小跌0.05%左右。
元大投顧認為，聯準會通過升息 1 碼將目標區調高至 3.75%到 4%，也是 2023 年 7 月來首次升息，但聯準會主席華許表示經濟依然強勁，可在不損害就業市場下恢復物價穩定，因此，台股在各項變數漸漸釐清後，可望展開季底作帳行情，惟個股將強弱分明。
統一投顧則指出，上周全球央行周和美日升息後，美國10年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂和繼續升息的緊張情緒，而儘管中東地緣政治局勢動盪、國際債市與匯市波動加劇、AI 放緩雜音增多，但整體風險可控，再考量美伊再次出現重啟談判曙光，可提振市場風險偏好。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar stayed on the stronger side throughout the day on the 21st, ending at NT$31.758, a gain of 0.05, with the turnover at Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanding to US$2.267 billion.
After opening at NT$31.79, up 0.018, the NTD peaked at NT$31.716, with a daily high‑low range of 0.074.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged more than 1%, the NTD rose 0.16%, the Thai baht gained over 0.1%, the Chinese yuan appreciated about 0.05%, the Singapore dollar hovered near flat, the Japanese yen fell about 0.2% against the trend, and the US dollar index slipped roughly 0.05%.

Yuanta Securities believes that the Fed’s 1‑percentage‑point rate hike, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4%, marks the first increase since July 2023. Fed Chair Jerome Powell said the economy remains strong and price stability can be restored without harming the labor market, so after variables are clarified, Taiwan’s stock market could see end‑of‑quarter accounting activity, though individual stocks will show clear winners and losers.

Unified Securities notes that after last week’s global central‑bank meetings and US‑Japan rate hikes, the US 10‑year Treasury yield stalled, easing inflation concerns and the tension over further hikes. Despite geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East, heightened volatility in international bond and FX markets, and growing noise around a slowdown in AI, overall risk remains manageable. Moreover, renewed hopes of renewed US‑Iran talks could boost market risk appetite.

items.title: 〈房產〉保險業承作房貸上半年暴增1倍至790億元 越近年底資金越不寬鬆
items.title_en: Insurance Industry Mortgage Lending Surges to NT$79 billion in H1, Funding Tightens Toward Year‑End
paras: 來自保險業的房貸業務已傳出排撥並傾向保守應對，房市較易取得的便宜資金已不若以往。統計顯示，上半年保險公司新增房貸 789.7 億元、年增102.7%，銀行房貸卻不增反減。
根據聯徵中心資料顯示，2026年上半年保險公司新增房貸戶6402人，房貸金額達789.7億元，較去年同期成102.7%，同時間銀行房貸金額新增8731億元，反而較去年同期衰退0.7%，顯見部分購屋人明顯轉往向保險公司申請房貸，因此而出現房貸放款金額大增現象，但目前市場也傳出保險公司開始出現排撥或接案保守現象。
信義房屋(9940-TW)不動產企研室專案經理曾敬德指出，雖然央行第二套房貸成數放寬，但資金好不好借仍又是另一碼事，從第七波管制與銀行自主管理態度轉趨保守後，壽險公司與農漁會成為房貸借款的管道，在房市略為復甦與交屋量仍居高不下狀態下，市場對於房貸需求穩定，保險公司也會謹慎評估與合理調整利率，現在民眾要取得便宜的資金早已不若以往容易，尤其越靠近年底資金更不容易寬鬆。
曾敬德表示，壽險公司因為台股先前表現亮眼，可能出現保戶解約取得現金後轉進房市，跟銀行一樣也會面臨資金流出問題，難免需要控管一下流速，有房貸資金需求的民眾，可以和仲介或代書打聽哪些銀行近期放款比較積極，另外其他非傳統銀行的管道，如保險公司、純網銀、農漁會等都可以詢問看看，爭取比較有利的貸款條件。
統計顯示，2026年上半年房貸新增金額最多的還是銀行，金額達8731億元，但仍略低於去年同期，保險公司房貸則是增加789.7億元，較去年同期增加1倍，顯示購屋人向保險公司申請房貸的狀況踴躍。
paras_en: Mortgage business from the insurance sector has reportedly become more selective and conservative, and cheap financing that was once easy to obtain in the housing market is no longer as abundant. Statistics show that in the first half of the year insurance companies added NT$78.97 billion in new mortgages, a 102.7% year‑over‑year increase, while bank mortgage lending fell.

According to data from the Credit Information Center, insurance companies originated 6,402 new mortgage borrowers in the first half of 2026, with a total loan amount of NT$78.97 billion, up 102.7% from the same period last year. In contrast, banks added NT$87.31 billion in new mortgage loans, a 0.7% decline year‑over‑year, indicating that many homebuyers have shifted to applying for mortgages with insurance firms, driving a sharp rise in mortgage disbursements. However, the market is now reporting that insurance companies are beginning to tighten or adopt a more cautious approach to new cases.

Zeng Jingde, project manager of the real‑estate research unit at Sinyi Realty (9940‑TW), noted that although the central bank has relaxed the loan‑to‑value ratio for second homes, obtaining funding remains a separate challenge. Since the seventh round of regulatory tightening and banks’ shift toward more conservative self‑management, life insurers and agricultural‑fishermen cooperatives have become alternative mortgage channels. With the housing market showing modest recovery and delivery volumes still high, demand for mortgages stays steady. Insurance firms will carefully assess and adjust rates, and it is now harder for the public to secure cheap financing, especially as the year‑end approaches when liquidity tightens further.

Zeng explained that life insurers, having benefited from strong recent performance in the Taiwan stock market, may see policyholders cash out and re‑enter the housing market, creating outflows similar to banks and forcing insurers to manage cash flow. Prospective borrowers should inquire with agents or notaries about which banks are currently active in loan disbursement, and also consider non‑traditional sources such as insurance companies, pure‑online banks, and agricultural‑fishermen cooperatives to obtain more favorable loan terms.

Statistics show that in the first half of 2026, banks still originated the largest amount of new mortgage loans at NT$87.31 billion, albeit slightly below the same period last year. Insurance companies added NT$78.97 billion, roughly double the amount from a year earlier, indicating a vigorous uptake of mortgage financing from insurers by homebuyers.

items.title: 華紙台東紙漿廠火災 初估損失1200萬元
items.title_en: Hua Paper Taitung Pulp Mill Fire Estimated Loss of NT$12 Million
paras: 華紙(1905-TW)台東回收紙存放局部區域昨(20)日上午11點45分因不明原因起火，今(21)日針對火警公告，同人發現後立即通知消防人員到場協助，火勢已獲控制，並且無人員受傷，初估損失約1200萬元。
華紙說明，該回收紙存放區域為獨立區域，因此廠房設備皆未受到波及，且公司已投保相關火災保險，扣除保險公司的應理賠金額後，初估損失約為1200萬元，對公司營運及財務無重大影響。華紙台東廠主要生產高級紙板、文化用紙以及再生與環保產品。
營運面上，因成本居高不下，華紙目前採減產、以庫存供應市場方式，減緩營運壓力，預計10月陸續恢復產能，若中國拉貨動能持續，市場約2至3個月就會出現供應吃緊情況，屆時價格可望進一步回升。此外，隨著第四季進到傳統旺季，普遍預期10月價格有望反彈。
paras_en: On the morning of the 20th at 11:45 a.m., a fire of unknown cause broke out in a partial area of Hua Paper's (1905‑TW) Taitung recycled paper storage facility. The company discovered the fire on the 21st, immediately notified fire crews, and the blaze was brought under control with no injuries reported. The initial loss is estimated at about NT$12 million.

Hua Paper explained that the recycled paper storage area is a separate zone, so the plant’s equipment was not affected. The company has fire insurance, and after deducting the insurer’s payable amount, the estimated loss remains around NT$12 million, which it says will not have a material impact on operations or finances. The Taitung plant primarily produces premium cardboard, cultural paper, and recycled and eco‑friendly products.

Operationally, facing high costs, Hua Paper is currently reducing output and supplying the market from inventory to ease pressure, with plans to gradually restore capacity from October. If Chinese demand continues, the market could tighten within two to three months, potentially pushing prices higher. Moreover, as the fourth quarter enters the traditional peak season, prices are generally expected to rebound in October.

items.title: 4.75%！兩年債突變得很吃香　利率期權顯示市場開始押Fed不會升太兇 但最大變數是「它」
items.title_en: 4.75%! Two‑Year Bonds Suddenly Hot – Rate Options Show Market Betting the Fed Won’t Hike Too Aggressively, Yet the Biggest Variable Is “It”
paras: 美國短天期公債近期出現一波「逆勢回補」行情，投資人重新加碼兩年期美債，不是因為看壞美國經濟，而是認為聯準會(Fed)重啟升息後，市場已把過多緊縮預期提前反映到短端直利率。一旦通膨改善、實際升息幅度低於目前定價，兩年期殖利率回落、債價就有修復空間。兩年期美債對Fed政策最敏感，自今年2月低點以來殖利率已上揚約140個基點。
Fed上周三(16日)決議升息1碼至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，12名FOMC委員全票通過，會後兩年期美債殖利率衝上約4.75%，創多年新高，期貨與利率交換市場計入未來一年再緊縮約數10個至80個基點，部分曲線定價甚至指向明年9月政策利率約4.68%。
WisdomTree投資策略主管Kevin Flanagan指出，兩年期美債殖利率明顯高於當前政策利率，代表短端可能「走得太遠」。若要在殖利率曲線上找過度調整的位置，短端最突出。這也是近期資金回流兩年債的核心：假設Fed終能壓低通膨，當前4.75%附近收益率可視為安全墊，即使後續仍升息，只要路徑沒有市場目前計價那麼鷹，債價就有資本利得。
另據《彭博資訊》報導，與擔保隔夜融資利率(SOFR)連動、可在利率下行獲利的選擇權買盤增加。SOFR與Fed政策預期高度相關，顯示部分資金押緊縮預期過度。
Allspring Global Investments固定收益首席策略師George Bory表示，在Fed主席華許於傑克森霍爾央行年會上強調重建物價穩定後已加碼債券，並把久期適度向中期延伸，因中短債對長期通膨、財政與期限溢價敏感度較低，但票面收益已處近年高位。
Barings多資產組合解決方案主管Trevor Slaven也說，當前短端直利率是「最易形成明確價值判斷」的區域。他以約4.75%兩年期殖利率對比交換市場所隱含2027年9月約4.68%政策利率，認為市場已計入額外三次升息，實際發生機率不高。對持有到期者，4.75%票息本身就是回報；對主動操作者，若通膨或終點利率低於預期，還有價差可賺。
然而，這筆交易不是無險。中東與俄烏情勢持續，能源價格若再飆，恐把整體通膨與收支預期推高，逼Fed升息升得比市場更猛。
美銀策略師已提醒必須防基準利率最終升至5%以上，華許在9月升息後稱此次只是移除部分「寬鬆成分」，市場解讀為貨幣政策尚未明顯扼制經濟活動。
Columbia Threadneedle投資組合經理Ed Al-Hussainy則說，最難的是判斷一年後終點利率，過往每輪升息市場都曾低估Fed最終幅度。油價便是變數，因美伊局勢緩和則原油回跌、通膨預期降，而中東供應中斷擴大，則能源再成推升利率的力量。
Fed最新點陣圖的中位數傾向今年再升一次、2027年維穩，但官員公開路徑仍落後於市場定價；兩年期美債殖利率已跑在聯邦基金區間上方，讓短債同時具「高票息」與「政策錯價回補」兩種屬性。這也解釋周二(22日)690億美元兩年債拍賣為何受矚，因為承銷利率與投標倍數若表現穩健，代表短端「過度升息定價」獲更多資金認可；若得標殖利率再上、需求偏軟，則說明市場仍相信華許會把抗通膨做到通膨趨勢明確回2%為止。
整體看，短端美債正出現罕見窗口：殖利率因激進緊縮預期大漲，卻吸引看好通膨受控、實際升息低於定價的資金。周二拍賣結果、SOFR選擇權與兩年期走勢，將成為未來數周觀察「市場是否過度鷹派」的最直接三個標的。
paras_en: U.S. short‑term Treasury bonds have recently experienced a wave of “contrarian buying back,” as investors increase exposure to two‑year Treasuries—not because they are pessimistic about the U.S. economy, but because they believe that after the Fed resumes rate hikes the market has already priced too much tightening into short‑end yields. If inflation eases and the actual rate‑hike magnitude ends up lower than current pricing, the two‑year yield should fall and bond prices have room to recover. The two‑year note is the most Fed‑sensitive segment, having risen about 140 basis points since its low in February this year.

The Fed on Wednesday (the 16th) voted to raise rates by one quarter‑point to a target range of 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023, with all 12 FOMC members voting in favor. After the decision, the two‑year Treasury yield spiked to roughly 4.75%, a multi‑year high, while futures and interest‑rate swap markets priced an additional 10‑80 basis points of tightening over the next year, and some curve pricing even implied a policy rate of about 4.68% by September 2025.

Kevin Flanagan, head of investment strategy at WisdomTree, noted that the two‑year yield is clearly above the current policy rate, suggesting the short end may have “run too far.” If one looks for an over‑adjusted spot on the yield curve, the short end stands out. This is the core reason for the recent flow back into two‑year bonds: assuming the Fed can eventually bring inflation down, the current ~4.75% yield can be seen as a safe cushion, and even if rates rise further, as long as the path isn’t as hawkish as the market currently prices, bond prices can generate capital gains.

Bloomberg reports that buying pressure on options linked to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR)—which profit from a decline in rates—has increased. SOFR is highly correlated with Fed policy expectations, indicating that some investors are over‑betting on tightening.

George Bory, chief fixed‑income strategist at Allspring Global Investments, said that after Fed Chair Waller emphasized rebuilding price stability at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium, he has added to bonds and modestly extended duration toward the medium term, because intermediate‑term debt is less sensitive to long‑term inflation, fiscal concerns, and term premia, while its coupon is already near multi‑year highs.

Trevor Slaven, head of multi‑asset solutions at Barings, added that the current short‑end yield is the “area where a clear value judgement is easiest.” Comparing the roughly 4.75% two‑year yield with the implied policy rate of about 4.68% for September 2027 from the swap market, he believes the market has priced in three additional hikes that are unlikely to materialize. For hold‑to‑maturity investors, the 4.75% coupon itself is the return; for active traders, there is still price spread to capture if inflation or the terminal rate ends up lower than expected.

However, the trade is not risk‑free. Ongoing tensions in the Middle East and the Russia‑Ukraine war could push energy prices higher again, raising overall inflation and balance‑sheet expectations and forcing the Fed to hike more aggressively than the market anticipates.

Bank of America strategists have warned that the benchmark rate could ultimately rise above 5%. After Waller’s September hike, he described the move as merely stripping away part of the “accommodative component,” which markets read as monetary policy still not strongly curbing economic activity.

Ed Al‑Hussainy, portfolio manager at Columbia Threadneedle, said the hardest part is forecasting the terminal rate a year out, noting that past tightening cycles have often seen the market underestimate the Fed’s final stance. Oil prices remain a wildcard: a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions could pull crude lower and ease inflation expectations, while a widening supply disruption in the Middle East could push energy‑driven rate pressures higher again.

The latest Fed dot‑plot median leans toward one more hike this year and a steady rate through 2027, but officials’ public guidance still lags market pricing. The two‑year yield now sits above the fed‑funds target range, giving short‑term debt both a “high coupon” and a “policy mis‑pricing correction” characteristic. This explains why the $69 billion two‑year auction on Tuesday the 22nd attracted attention: a solid underwriting rate and bid‑to‑cover ratio would signal that the market acknowledges the “over‑priced aggressive hike” on the short end, while a higher winning yield and soft demand would suggest investors still believe Waller will keep fighting inflation until the trend clearly returns to 2%.

Overall, the short‑end Treasury market is presenting a rare window: yields have surged on aggressive tightening expectations, yet they are drawing capital that believes inflation will be contained and that actual rate hikes will be lower than priced. The outcome of Tuesday’s auction, SOFR option activity, and the two‑year trend will be the three most direct gauges over the coming weeks of whether the market is being overly hawkish.

items.title: 美國柴油零售價首度突破6.5美元 期中選舉前夕加劇通膨壓力
items.title_en: U.S. Diesel Retail Price Breaks $6.5 per Gallon for the First Time, Heightening Inflation Pressure Ahead of Midterm Elections
paras: 根據美國汽車協會(AAA)最新數據，美國全國柴油平均零售價格已升至每加侖6.505美元，創下歷史新高。自美伊衝突爆發以來，柴油價格已暴漲約70%，單在9月份就大幅上漲超過87美分，一舉打破2022年俄烏戰爭初期創下的每加侖5.81美元高點。
儘管經通膨調整後實質價格仍略低於2022年峰值，但高漲的能源成本已對運輸、農業及家庭供暖造成沉重的費用負擔。
柴油供應吃緊主要受到雙重打擊。首先，美伊戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽的航運受阻，原油與成品油運輸受限，全球煉油廠產能無法全面恢復。其次，烏克蘭無人機襲擊俄羅斯煉油廠後，俄國當局實施柴油出口禁令並可能延長至10月，進一步加劇全球燃料供應緊張。
隨著美國期中選舉臨近，柴油暴漲恐削弱川普政府與共和黨在農業大州愛荷華州，以及依賴供暖油的緬因州之選民支持。
市場傳出白宮或將實施柴油出口限制以平抑國內油價，但國家能源主導委員會主席、內政部長伯古姆(Doug Burgum)坦言，禁令未必能有效降價。此外，頑固的通膨壓力已促使聯準會上周升息1碼(0.25個百分點)，是自2023年以來首次升息。
高盛警告，在全球供應持續受限下，柴油價格仍有進一步推升的空間。
paras_en: According to the latest data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), the average retail price of diesel nationwide has risen to $6.505 per gallon, a historic high. Since the outbreak of the U.S.-Iran conflict, diesel prices have surged about 70%, and in September alone they jumped more than 87 cents, shattering the $5.81 per‑gallon peak set early in the 2022 Russia‑Ukraine war.

Even after adjusting for inflation, the real price remains slightly below the 2022 peak, but the soaring energy costs are imposing a heavy financial burden on transportation, agriculture and household heating.

Diesel supply is tightening due to a double blow. First, the U.S.-Iran war has disrupted shipping through the Hormuz Strait, limiting the transport of crude oil and refined products and preventing global refineries from fully restoring capacity. Second, after Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries, Russian authorities imposed a diesel export ban that may be extended into October, further tightening global fuel supplies.

With the U.S. midterm elections approaching, the diesel price spike could erode support for the Trump administration and the Republican Party among voters in the agricultural heavyweight Iowa and in heating‑oil‑dependent Maine.

Reports suggest the White House may consider imposing diesel export restrictions to ease domestic fuel prices, but Doug Burgum, chair of the National Energy Advisory Committee and Secretary of the Interior, warned that a ban might not effectively lower prices. In addition, stubborn inflation pressure prompted the Federal Reserve to raise rates by one basis point (0.25 percentage point) last week, its first hike since 2023.
Goldman Sachs warned that, with global supply still constrained, diesel prices have further upside potential.

items.title: 輔助工具變執法主力？FBI局長宣稱AI使用量暴增605%   但數據遭質疑
items.title_en: Auxiliary Tools Becoming Main Enforcement Force? FBI Director Claims AI Use Surged 605% but Data Questioned
paras: 美國聯邦調查局(FBI)局長Kash Patel上周六(19日)接受《福斯新聞》專訪時表示，經由他的推動，FBI對AI技術的使用量實現了605%的成長，並稱AI「如果依法使用，就是進行資料篩選分類的關鍵工具」，對於保護兒童、防範校園槍擊案具極高價值，並列舉AI在跟進線索、阻止北卡羅來納州及「另外六個州」發生槍擊事件中的作用。
但Patel在訪談中未交代605%究竟統計了什麼，FBI幾乎沒有確鑿的公開數據說明其在多大範圍、以何種方式導入AI，「使用量」究竟指調用次數、用戶人數、項目數量還是採購規模。
可公開核驗的資料，僅能側面支撐FBI在AI「部署規模在擴張」。美國司法部2025年度AI應用項目清單顯示，歸屬FBI的AI應用案例共50項，其中9項被標記為「高影響力項目」，而該局首席AI長Katie Noyes上月曾稱，FBI獲批投入使用的AI應用案例已達139項，約為年初統計的三倍。
去年，美國聯邦總務署正式批准Claude、Gemini與ChatGPT進入政府可用產品名錄，向各政府機構開放。
今年5月，美國國防部與8家AI企業簽署合作協議。 FBI本身則在數月前發布採購文件，面向廠商徵集報價，打算斥資8800萬美元採購AI伺服器，顯示其有意進一步擴大AI業務部署。
Patel上周二(15日)在參議院聽證會上透露，他可以直接聯繫多家重量級AI企業執行長，並稱這些企業負責人均配合FBI在執法事務上的協作訴求。他同時提出，能夠存取廠商的大模型，有助於打擊借助AI實施的犯罪，犯罪集團已利用模型蒸餾攻擊手段自行搭建專用AI模型。FBI現已設定專門分類標籤，用於統計各類與AI相關的犯罪，在最新網路犯罪報告中，投資詐騙、婚戀騙局與虛假求職詐騙被列為AI犯罪的熱點領域。
在實際操作上，Patel今年5月曾在專欄刊文指出，借助人臉識別等AI工具，失蹤兒童尋回數量提升30%，虐童案件逮捕人數上升20%，FBI也已啟用AI工具完成通話錄音轉寫、生成內容精簡摘要，並輔助梳理人員聯絡關係、關聯其他報案線索。
他特別提到，分析師團隊以往處理憑搜索令調取到的海量通訊資訊往往要耗費數週，而AI可以顯著壓縮這一時間。
Patel列舉的多項成效來自FBI內部工具與數據，外界無法重複驗證，605%的增幅因此更像是一句政治傳播意義上的業績宣示，而非可審計的量化結論。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Director Kash Patel told Fox News in an interview last Saturday (the 19th) that, thanks to his push, the FBI’s use of AI technology has grown 605%, calling AI “a key tool for data filtering and classification when used lawfully” and saying it is extremely valuable for protecting children and preventing school shootings, citing AI’s role in following leads and averting shootings in North Carolina and “six other states.”

However, Patel did not explain what the 605% actually measures; the FBI has virtually no public data showing the scope or manner of its AI adoption, and it is unclear whether “usage” refers to call volume, number of users, number of projects, or procurement size.

The only publicly verifiable information merely supports the notion that the FBI’s AI “deployment scale is expanding.” The Department of Justice’s 2025 AI application project list shows 50 AI use cases attributed to the FBI, nine of which are flagged as “high‑impact projects,” and the agency’s chief AI officer Katie Noyes said last month that the FBI now has 139 approved AI applications, roughly three times the count at the start of the year.

Last year the U.S. General Services Administration formally approved Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT for inclusion in the government‑approved product catalog, making them available to all federal agencies.

In May of this year the Department of Defense signed cooperation agreements with eight AI firms. The FBI itself released a procurement solicitation a few months ago, seeking vendor quotes for $88 million in AI servers, indicating its intent to further expand AI deployments.

Patel told a Senate hearing on Tuesday (the 15th) that he can directly contact the CEOs of several heavyweight AI companies, and that these leaders are cooperating with the FBI’s law‑enforcement needs. He added that access to vendors’ large models helps combat crimes that leverage AI, noting that criminal groups have used model‑distillation attacks to build custom AI models. The FBI has now created specific classification tags to track AI‑related crimes, and its latest internet‑crime report lists investment fraud, romance scams and fake job scams as hot AI‑crime domains.

In practice, Patel wrote in a May column that using AI tools such as facial‑recognition has increased the recovery rate of missing children by 30% and boosted arrests in child‑abuse cases by 20%. The FBI also uses AI to transcribe phone calls, generate concise summaries, and assist in mapping personnel contacts and linking other reports.
He specifically noted that analysts previously spent weeks sifting through massive volumes of communications obtained via search warrants, whereas AI can dramatically compress that time.

The many successes Patel cites come from internal FBI tools and data that outsiders cannot independently verify, making the 605% jump appear more like a political talking point than an auditable quantitative conclusion.

items.title: 還沒動工就惹官司 馬斯克Terafab遭要求停用名稱
items.title_en: Lawsuit Before Groundbreaking: Musk's Terafab Faces Demand to Halt Use of Name
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 規劃中的超級晶片工廠尚未動工，卻先因名稱捲入商標爭議。兩家公司周日(20日)向美國德州奧斯汀聯邦法院提起訴訟，針對奈米科技公司TERA-print提出的商標侵權指控尋求司法裁決，盼為「Terafab」名稱正名。
爭議核心在於，馬斯克團隊籌備的晶片計畫命名為「Terafab」，但位於美國伊利諾州的TERA-print已持有「Tera-Fab」註冊商標。
特斯拉早在今年5月便向美國專利商標局提出3項與「Terafab」相關的商標申請，但隨著計畫推進，TERA-print向特斯拉及SpaceX發出停用通知，主張「Terafab」與「Tera-Fab」高度相似，已構成商標侵權，要求兩家公司立即停止使用。
雙方先前曾多次協商，希望化解名稱爭議，最近一次溝通是在9月2日，但最終未能達成共識。
TERA-print表明將積極維護自身商標權益，並認為特斯拉與SpaceX的晶片工廠計畫，與其商標涵蓋的商品及服務領域有所重疊，可能造成市場混淆。
在協商破局後，特斯拉與SpaceX決定主動訴諸法律。兩家公司在訴狀中駁斥侵權說法，強調雙方的業務場景、技術方向及客戶群均不相同，因此不致造成混淆。
TERA-print的核心產品為應用於生物工程領域的桌上型光刻列印設備，主要鎖定小型精密奈米製造設備市場。
相較之下，特斯拉與SpaceX規劃的Terafab，定位為工業級超級晶片工廠，兩者產品用途與市場明顯不同，這也成為特斯拉及SpaceX主張未侵權的重要依據。
這起名稱爭議之所以受到關注，也與Terafab在馬斯克事業布局中的重要性有關。
依規劃，工廠將落腳美國德州格萊姆斯郡（Grimes County），是一座整合先進邏輯晶片、記憶體晶片製造、封裝及測試的綜合性晶片基地。
Terafab生產的晶片將供應特斯拉人形機器人Optimus、自駕計程車Cybercab，以及SpaceX太空資料中心，支援馬斯克在智慧機器人與太空科技領域的核心業務。
一方是持有在先註冊商標、堅持維權的奈米科技公司，另一方則是將Terafab視為關鍵晶片布局、不願更名的特斯拉與SpaceX。
晶片工廠尚未正式投產，名稱之爭已率先進入司法程序，Terafab能否保留原名，將由法院裁定。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) have not yet broken ground on their planned super‑chip factory, but the project is already embroiled in a trademark dispute over its name. On Sunday the two companies filed a lawsuit in the U.S. Federal Court in Austin, Texas, seeking a judicial ruling on the trademark infringement claims brought by nanotech firm TERA‑print, hoping to vindicate the “Terafab” name.
The crux of the dispute is that Musk’s team has named the chip project “Terafab,” while TERA‑print, based in Illinois, already holds a registered trademark for “Tera‑Fab.”

Tesla filed three trademark applications related to “Terafab” with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office in May of this year, but as the project progressed TERA‑print sent cease‑and‑desist notices to Tesla and SpaceX, asserting that “Terafab” is highly similar to “Tera‑Fab,” constitutes infringement, and demanding that the two companies stop using the name immediately.
The parties had previously engaged in multiple rounds of negotiation to resolve the naming issue, the most recent being on September 2, but ultimately failed to reach an agreement.

TERA‑print stated it will vigorously protect its trademark rights and believes that Tesla’s and SpaceX’s chip‑factory plan overlaps with the goods and services covered by its trademark, potentially causing market confusion.

After negotiations broke down, Tesla and SpaceX chose to pursue legal action. In their complaint they reject the infringement allegations, emphasizing that the business contexts, technology focus, and customer bases of the two parties are distinct and therefore unlikely to cause confusion.
TERA‑print’s core product is a tabletop photolithography printer for the bio‑engineering field, targeting the market for small‑scale precision nanomanufacturing equipment.

In contrast, the Terafab planned by Tesla and SpaceX is positioned as an industrial‑grade super‑chip fab, with product uses and markets that are clearly different, which forms the basis of Tesla’s and SpaceX’s claim of non‑infringement.
The naming dispute has attracted attention because of Terafab’s strategic importance within Musk’s broader business portfolio.
According to the plan, the factory will be located in Grimes County, Texas, and will be an integrated chip campus combining advanced logic chip, memory chip manufacturing, packaging and testing.

The chips produced at Terafab will supply Tesla’s humanoid robot Optimus, the autonomous taxi Cybercab, and SpaceX’s space data center, supporting Musk’s core businesses in intelligent robotics and space technology.

One side is a nanotech company that holds a prior‑registered trademark and is determined to enforce its rights; the other side is Tesla and SpaceX, which view Terafab as a critical chip strategy and are unwilling to rename it.
The chip factory has not yet begun production, but the naming battle has already entered the courts; whether Terafab can retain its original name will be decided by the judge.

items.title: 離開賣僅剩一月！傳蘋果iPhone Duo整機組裝良率只有六成多　富士康量產爬坡未完成
items.title_en: Only One Month Left Until Launch! Apple iPhone Duo’s Full‑Device Assembly Yield Just Over 60% – Foxconn’s Mass Production Ramp‑Up Still Incomplete
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，蘋果首款摺疊機iPhone Duo距10月23日開賣只剩一個多月，但量產爬坡仍未達標。iPhone Duo在9月10日由新任執行長特納斯在秋季發布會推出，10月16日預售、10月23日上市。
《界面新聞》上周四(17日)援引接近富士康產業鏈人士消息報導指出，目前富士康整機組裝良率僅60%多，首批產量偏少；按蘋果現有品質標準，整機良率要到成熟水平恐需要再半年，甚至一年。供應鏈正等待蘋果決策，是否放寬品質要求以換取更快大規模量產。
對比過去五年蘋果秋季旗艦從發布到預售平均約3天、到上市平均約10天，Duo兩階段時間分別拉長到36天與43天，多出的約一個月主要用於產線調試。
產業鏈人士表示，良率偏低不完全是單項技術未解決，而是首次量產折疊機，設備、工序、參數都要「邊生產邊調試」；三星顯示OLED面板、鉸鏈相關零組件此前均出現過良率不足、交付推遲與方案調整，上游任一環節延誤都會壓縮整機廠調機時間。
瑞穗證券9月3日曾出具研報指出，鉸鏈規格與螢幕摺痕是拖慢整機量產的核心變數。
摺疊機的難點集中在「螢幕＋鉸鏈＋裝配」。iPhone Duo內螢幕採客製化奈米紋理UTG超薄玻璃，中間更薄、兩側加厚以兼顧彎曲與強度，配合特殊膠層釋放彎曲應力、奈米紋理分散反射光，降低摺痕可視度。軟性螢幕下方再由支撐板與100多個零件組成的鉸鏈共同托平中央，鉸鏈須控制開合阻力、彎曲半徑，並在超薄機身內兼顧輕量、耐用與防塵防水。
產業鏈曾傳出蘋果評估部分鉸鏈零件使用液態金屬，量產前述重新打樣驗證；即便不改材料，沖壓、CNC、MIM等多工藝疊加，也讓公差控制遠難於直板機。

在這套新體系中，中國供應鏈由「蓋板組裝」走向核心精密製造。藍思科技供應奈米紋理UTG、CPI膜、支撐板與3D蓋板，機構調研稱摺疊項目單機價值明顯高於直板；領益智造供應鉸鏈精密結構件、螢幕支撐板、超薄VC均熱板及帶法蘭超薄不鏽鋼電池殼，因Duo展開約5.2毫米、鉸鏈佔中央空間，電池、主板、散熱分置兩側，電池殼太薄易皺裂、太厚佔電量，VC又要給A20 Pro晶片散熱且不擠佔空間。中國珠海冠宇提供電芯，強瑞技術做檢測治具與試製驗證，榮旗科技參與VC散熱檢測，鴻富瀚供功能性結構件。
分析師表示，沒有中國供應鏈，摺疊機很難以現有成本與規模做成消費級產品，但利潤與議價權能否向上遊材料、總成、共同設計延伸，仍要看後續良率。
備貨方面，產業鏈人士估Duo今年全球備貨600萬至800萬台；終端通路銷售指引超500萬台。對比單款Pro或Pro Max產品周期通常2000萬至3000萬台，首代摺疊屬小批量嘗鮮。
根據Omdia數據，2025年全球摺疊機出貨1820萬台、年增6%，同期智慧手機出貨量約12.6億台，滲透率約1.4%；今年上半年出貨510萬台、年降21.6%，其中豎摺疊機降47%、橫向書本式大致持平。
雖然三星2019年已入局，華為、榮耀、小米、OPPO、vivo持續推陳出新，但摺疊機仍未能成為大眾品類。業內對蘋果入局仍給「打開市場」的期待，其全球銷量、開發者生態與供應鏈號召力，有望解決摺疊機長期痛點，用戶少、App多只把直板界面橫拉放大，分屏、報表、多任務未重做。
業內人士認為，若Duo首年帶來數百萬新增用戶，開發者適配大屏回報提升，摺疊機才有機會從「能折的直板」變成獨立生態。
短期看，Duo首發更可能供不應求；中長期看，產業鏈人士預計隨產能爬坡與v15級軟硬體迭代，Duo系列未來兩、三年可望升至2000萬至3000萬台規模，才真正進入蘋果主力產品序列。
對富士康與零組件廠而言，未來半年良率能否從六成多爬到九成附近，將決定這場「摺疊翻身」是技術樣板還是銷量主戰場。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Apple’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, is just over a month away from its October 23 launch, but its mass‑production ramp‑up has not yet hit target. The iPhone Duo was unveiled by new CEO Tim Cook at the autumn event on September 10, with pre‑orders slated for October 16 and sales beginning on October 23.

Jiemian News cited sources close to Foxconn’s supply chain on Thursday (the 17th) saying Foxconn’s full‑device assembly yield is only a little over 60%, resulting in a small initial output; under Apple’s current quality standards, reaching a mature yield could take another six months to a year. The supply chain is waiting for Apple’s decision on whether to relax quality requirements to accelerate large‑scale production.

Compared with the past five years where Apple’s autumn flagships took about three days from announcement to pre‑order and roughly ten days to market, the Duo’s two phases have been stretched to 36 days and 43 days respectively, with the extra month mainly spent on production‑line debugging.

Industry insiders say the low yield is not solely due to a single unresolved technology; it’s the first time a foldable is being mass‑produced, so equipment, processes and parameters must be “tuned while producing.” Samsung’s OLED panels and hinge components have previously suffered yield shortfalls, delivery delays and design revisions, and any upstream delay compresses the overall device tuning time.
Mizuho Securities issued a research note on September 3 stating that hinge specifications and screen crease are the core variables slowing full‑device production.

The foldable’s difficulty centers on “screen + hinge + assembly.” The Duo’s inner screen uses a custom nano‑textured ultra‑thin glass (UTG) that is thinner in the middle and thicker on the edges to balance flexibility and strength, combined with a special adhesive layer that releases bending stress and nano‑texture that diffuses reflected light to reduce visible creases. Beneath the flexible screen, a support plate and a hinge made of over 100 parts keep the center flat; the hinge must control opening resistance and bend radius while fitting into an ultra‑thin chassis that remains lightweight, durable and dust‑ and water‑proof.

There were reports that Apple evaluated using liquid metal for some hinge parts and re‑validated the design before mass production; even without material changes, the combination of stamping, CNC, MIM and other processes makes tolerance control far more difficult than for a flat‑panel device.

In this new ecosystem, China’s supply chain moves from “cover‑plate assembly” to core precision manufacturing. Lens Technology supplies nano‑textured UTG, CPI film, support plates and 3D cover plates, and research shows the foldable module’s per‑unit value is clearly higher than a flat panel; Lingyi Manufacturing provides precision hinge components, screen support plates, ultra‑thin VC heat‑spreader plates and flanged ultra‑thin stainless‑steel battery shells. Because the Duo opens about 5.2 mm and the hinge occupies central space, the battery, motherboard and cooling are split to the sides, making the battery shell prone to cracking if too thin or to excess weight if too thick, while the VC must dissipate heat from the A20 Pro chip without taking up space. Zhuhai Crownstar supplies cells, StrongTech makes test fixtures and pilot verification, Rongqi Technology participates in VC thermal testing, and Hongfuhan provides functional structural parts.

Analysts say that without China’s supply chain, making a consumer‑grade foldable at current cost and scale would be extremely difficult, but whether higher margins and bargaining power can extend upstream to materials, modules and co‑design will depend on future yields.

Regarding inventory, industry sources estimate Foxconn will stock 6‑8 million Duo units worldwide this year; retail guidance points to sales of over 5 million units. By contrast, a single Pro or Pro Max model typically runs 20‑30 million units in its cycle, so the first‑generation foldable is a small‑batch trial.

Omdia data project global foldable shipments of 18.2 million units in 2025, a 6 % year‑over‑year increase, versus roughly 1.26 billion smartphones, giving a penetration of about 1.4 %. In the first half of this year, shipments fell 21.6 % to 5.1 million units, with vertical foldables down 47 % while horizontal book‑type devices remained roughly flat.

Although Samsung entered the market in 2019 and Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo continue to iterate, foldables have not become a mass‑market category. Industry insiders still hope Apple’s entry will “open the market,” as its global sales reach, developer ecosystem and supply‑chain pull could address long‑standing foldable pain points—few users and apps that merely stretch a flat‑screen UI without redesigning split‑screen, reporting or multitasking features.

Industry observers believe that if the Duo brings several million new users in its first year and developers see a return on adapting apps for larger screens, foldables could evolve from “foldable flat phones” into a distinct ecosystem.

In the short term, the Duo’s launch is likely to be supply‑constrained; in the medium to long term, as capacity ramps and v15‑level hardware‑software iterations roll out, the Duo series could reach 20‑30 million units within two to three years, finally becoming a core Apple product line.

For Foxconn and component makers, whether the yield can climb from just over 60 % to around 90 % in the next six months will determine if this “foldable turnaround” becomes a technical showcase or a major sales battleground.

items.title: AI造富！富比士40歲以下億萬富豪增至10位 Anthropic佔4席
items.title_en: AI Creates Wealth! Forbes Lists 10 Billionaires Under 40, Anthropic Holds Four Seats
paras: 《富比士》公布2026年美國400大富豪榜，今年40歲以下億萬富翁人數由去年的4位增至10位，其中7名30多歲富豪靠自身創業累積財富，且全數受惠於人工智慧（AI）熱潮。AI新創Anthropic更一舉占據4席，成為本屆榜單焦點。
今年要躋身《富比士》400大富豪榜，淨資產門檻達到創紀錄的44億美元。
新上榜的年輕富豪中，Anthropic共同創辦人占據半壁江山，包括39歲的湯姆布朗（Tom Brown）、39歲的阿莫迪（Daniela Amodei）、37歲的傑克克拉克（Jack Clark），以及36歲的麥克蘭迪什（Sam McCandlish）。4人淨資產估計均達155億美元，並列榜單第75名。
Anthropic成立於2021年，由7名離開OpenAI的員工共同創辦。這群創辦人認為，OpenAI開發AI的腳步過快，未充分重視安全與信任問題，因此另起爐灶。如今7名共同創辦人中，有4人成為本屆榜單最年輕的10名富豪之一，另有2人雖已超過40歲，也在今年首次入榜。
Anthropic旗下AI模型Claude快速崛起，公司今年5月完成650億美元融資後，估值攀升至9,650億美元。7名共同創辦人今年稍早也承諾，最終將捐出個人財富的80%。
不過，隨著OpenAI本月推出GPT-6 Astra，Anthropic正面臨更激烈競爭。路透引述知情人士報導，Anthropic正在考慮推出全新AI模型因應，並可能把首次公開募股（IPO）延後至美國11月中期選舉之後，先前消息則指公司最快可能於10月中旬啟動路演。
部分投資人給予Anthropic最高達2兆美元的估值預期。若順利實現，將超越SpaceX今年6月上市時約1.77兆美元的估值，成為史上規模最大的IPO。
數據顯示，GPT-6 Astra已獲得企業用戶青睞，目前占企業AI相關支出約13%，高於Anthropic Claude Fable的8%。OpenRouter數據也顯示，上周用戶對OpenAI模型的支出，兩年半來首度超過Anthropic。
不過，截至7月，Anthropic年化營收已超過650億美元，仍高於OpenAI的400億美元。
除Anthropic創辦團隊外，38歲的OpenAI共同創辦人兼總裁布羅克曼也新進榜。他今年5月在與馬斯克的法律糾紛中宣誓表示，所持OpenAI股份價值超過200億美元。OpenAI與Anthropic今年夏季都已祕密提交上市申請。
paras_en: Forbes released its 2026 list of the 400 richest Americans, and the number of billionaires under 40 rose from four last year to ten this year, with seven of the 30‑something magnates having built their fortunes through entrepreneurship and all benefiting from the artificial‑intelligence (AI) boom. The AI startup Anthropic captured four spots, becoming the headline act of this edition.
To make the 2026 Forbes 400 this year, a net‑worth threshold of a record‑high $4.4 billion was required.

Among the newly listed young billionaires, Anthropic co‑founders dominate half the spots, including 39‑year‑old Tom Brown, 39‑year‑old Daniela Amodei, 37‑year‑old Jack Clark and 36‑year‑old Sam McCandlish. All four have estimated net assets of $15.5 billion each, tying for rank 75 on the list.

Anthropic was founded in 2021 by seven former OpenAI employees who felt OpenAI was moving too quickly on AI development without giving enough attention to safety and trust, prompting them to start their own venture. Of the seven co‑founders, four are now among the ten youngest billionaires on this year’s list, while two older than 40 also made their first appearance this year.

Anthropic’s AI model Claude has risen rapidly; after a $65 billion financing round in May, the company’s valuation climbed to $965 billion. Earlier this year the seven co‑founders pledged to eventually donate 80% of their personal wealth.

However, with OpenAI launching GPT‑6 Astra this month, Anthropic faces stiffer competition. Reuters, citing sources, reported that Anthropic is considering launching a new AI model in response and may push back its IPO until after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, although earlier reports suggested a roadshow could start as early as mid‑October.

Some investors have placed a valuation expectation on Anthropic as high as $2 trillion. If achieved, it would surpass SpaceX’s roughly $1.77 trillion valuation at its June IPO, making it the largest IPO ever.

Data show GPT‑6 Astra is already popular with corporate users, now accounting for about 13% of enterprise AI spending, compared with Anthropic’s Claude Fable at 8%. OpenRouter data also indicate that last week spending on OpenAI models finally exceeded Anthropic’s for the first time in two and a half years.
Nevertheless, as of July Anthropic’s annualized revenue has topped $65 billion, still higher than OpenAI’s $40 billion.

Beyond Anthropic’s founding team, 38‑year‑old OpenAI co‑founder and president Brockman also entered the list. In May, amid a legal dispute with Elon Musk, he swore that his OpenAI shares were worth over $20 billion. Both OpenAI and Anthropic filed confidential IPO applications this summer.

items.title: 首超GPU！小摩：2027年ASIC/XPU佔比54% 今年客製化AI ASIC規模約600-700億美元
items.title_en: Top GPU No More! JPMorgan: ASIC/XPU Share to Reach 54% in 2027, Custom AI ASIC Market About $60‑70 B This Year
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)最新半導體報告預估，AI加速器出貨結構將在2027年出現拐點，ASIC/XPU佔比由今年約41%升至54%，首次超過通用GPU，2028年再升至55%。若按數量估算，2027年ASIC/XPU約1250萬顆、GPU約1090萬顆。
報告同時估計，今年客製化AI ASIC市場規模約600億至700億美元，未來數年的年複合成長率超過40%至50%，成為半導體景氣核心增量。
驅動力來自雲端廠商自研趨勢。谷歌TPU、亞馬遜Trainium、微軟Maia、Meta MTIA等XPU針對大規模推理、推薦、訓練特定負載優化，目標是壓低每token成本、功耗與對通用GPU的單一依賴。
相較於「萬能」GPU，ASIC犧牲通用性換取能效與總擁有成本。小摩指出，這不是GPU被替代，而是AI基礎設施由「通用為主」轉向「GPU訓練＋客製化晶片規模化推理」雙軌。
目前，博通與邁威爾科技合計佔客製化AI ASIC市場約90%，其中博通約80%至85%，受益於谷歌長期TPU、Meta、OpenAI等客戶設計服務，邁威爾則大約10%至12%，涵蓋亞馬遜、微軟、谷歌部分互連與記憶體附加晶片。
小摩在報告中特別說明，谷歌TPU等供應鏈資訊不透明不等同訂單走弱，博通與谷歌5年協議涵蓋2026至2031年，橫跨3奈米、2奈米與先進封裝，並有逐年遞增營收安排，收入可見度較強。後續觀察點在2奈米產能、CoWoS/先進封裝、HBM配貨及雲端廠商自研量產節奏。若ASIC出貨如期過半，博通、邁威爾及周邊IP、先進封裝鏈將持續受惠，但客戶自研比例提升也會在中長期削弱設計服務商議價空間。
paras_en: JPMorgan (referred to as JPM) estimates in its latest semiconductor report that the AI accelerator shipment mix will hit a turning point in 2027, with ASIC/XPU share rising from roughly 41% this year to 54%, overtaking general‑purpose GPUs for the first time, and climbing to 55% in 2028. In unit terms, JPM projects about 12.5 million ASIC/XPU chips and 10.9 million GPUs shipped in 2027.

The report also estimates the custom AI ASIC market size at about $60 billion to $70 billion this year, with a compound annual growth rate of over 40%‑50% in the coming years, making it a core growth driver for the semiconductor cycle.

The driver is the cloud providers’ trend toward in‑house designs. Google’s TPU, Amazon’s Trainium, Microsoft’s Maia and Meta’s MTIA are XPU products optimized for large‑scale inference, recommendation and training workloads, aiming to lower per‑token cost, power consumption and dependence on general‑purpose GPUs.

Compared with the “universal” GPU, ASICs sacrifice flexibility for higher energy efficiency and lower total cost of ownership. JPM notes this is not a replacement of GPUs, but a shift of AI infrastructure from a “general‑purpose‑dominant” model to a dual‑track approach of “GPU training plus mass‑scale inference on custom chips.”

Currently Broadcom and Marvell together account for roughly 90% of the custom AI ASIC market, with Broadcom holding about 80%‑85% thanks to long‑term TPU, Meta, OpenAI and other customer design services, while Marvell captures about 10%‑12%, covering parts of Amazon, Microsoft and Google interconnect and memory‑side chips.

JPM specifically points out that opaque supply‑chain information for Google’s TPU does not imply weakening orders. Broadcom’s five‑year agreement with Google, covering 2026‑2031 and spanning 3 nm, 2 nm and advanced packaging, includes stepped‑up revenue targets, giving strong visibility. Future watch points include 2 nm capacity, CoWoS/advanced packaging, HBM allocation and the production pace of cloud providers’ in‑house designs. If ASIC shipments reach the projected share, Broadcom, Marvell and related IP, advanced‑packaging chains will continue to benefit, though a higher proportion of customer‑developed chips could erode design‑service firms’ bargaining power in the medium to long term.

items.title: 特斯拉機器人團隊在長三角審廠 多家企業接獲訂單
items.title_en: Tesla Robot Team Conducts Factory Audits in the Yangtze River Delta; Multiple Companies Receive Orders
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 機器人團隊落地寧波審廠一事受資本市場關注，產業鏈人士透露，特斯拉機器人團隊上周已於拓普集團(601689-CN) 、三花智控(02050-HK) 、均勝電子(600699-CN) 等供應鏈企業開啟審廠工作。
上述企業主要供給關節模組、執行器、精密結構件等核心機電部件。
「在本次審廠前，這些企業都已經拿到了特斯拉人形機器人的訂單，只是或多或少的區別。審廠將對相關產線品質、合規等方面展開評估，通過後將很快開始生產。」上述人士提到。
據《澎湃新聞》21日（周一）報導，該名產業鏈人士表示，審廠工作並非網傳的只在寧波展開，特斯拉該機器人團隊本次走訪工作還覆蓋杭州、上海等長三角地區供應鏈企業。相關企業基本也都是特斯拉已經有合作的供應鏈企業。
此前有消息稱，特斯拉計劃在今年生產數千台人形機器人。供應鏈審廠工作開啟，意味著特斯拉人形機器人量產工作更進一步。
特斯拉即將開啟量產的是第三代人形機器人，也是其第一款量產機型，相比前代，重點升級手部靈巧機構、關節執行器，優先承擔工廠內物料搬運、簡單流水線輔助等工業任務。單機長期目標成本為2萬～3萬美元。
產能方面，特斯拉原Model S/X生產線已經轉型為特斯拉人形機器人專用生產線，規劃年產能達100萬台。
同時，特斯拉正在德州超級工廠準備機器人第二條產線，長期設計年產能為1,000萬台，預計明年夏季左右投產。馬斯克稱人形機器人量產是特斯拉有史以來量產難度最大的產品。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) robot team’s factory audit in Ningbo has drawn attention from the capital markets. Industry insiders say the team began audits last week at supply‑chain firms including Top Group (601689-CN), SFA Control (02050-HK) and Joyson Electronics (600699-CN).
These companies mainly supply core electromechanical parts such as joint modules, actuators and precision structural components.

"Before these audits, all of these firms had already secured orders for Tesla’s humanoid robot, albeit with varying specifications. The audits will assess production‑line quality, compliance and other factors, and once passed, production will start quickly," the insider said.

According to a report by The Paper on Monday the 21st, the insider clarified that the audits are not limited to Ningbo as online rumors suggest; Tesla’s robot team is also visiting supply‑chain companies in Hangzhou, Shanghai and other parts of the Yangtze River Delta. The firms involved are essentially those already partnered with Tesla.

Earlier reports indicated that Tesla plans to produce several thousand humanoid robots this year. The launch of supply‑chain audits signals that mass production of the robots is moving a step further forward.

Tesla is about to begin mass production of its third‑generation humanoid robot, which will also be its first mass‑produced model. Compared with earlier versions, it features upgraded hand dexterity mechanisms and joint actuators, and will initially handle material handling and simple assembly‑line assistance tasks in factories.
