The long‑term target cost per unit is $20,000‑$30,000.
In terms of capacity, Tesla’s former Model S/X production line has been converted into a dedicated line for the humanoid robot, with a planned annual output of up to one million units.

At the same time, Tesla is preparing a second robot production line at its Texas Gigafactory, designed for a long‑term annual capacity of 10 million units and expected to start up around summer next year. Elon Musk says mass‑producing the humanoid robot will be the most challenging product Tesla has ever manufactured.

items.title: 4.75%！兩年債突變得很吃香　利率期權顯示市場開始押Fed不會升太兇 但最大變數是「它」
items.title_en: 4.75%! Two‑Year Bonds Suddenly Hot – Rate Options Show Market Betting the Fed Won’t Hike Too Aggressively, Yet the Biggest Variable Is “It”
paras: 美國短天期公債近期出現一波「逆勢回補」行情，投資人重新加碼兩年期美債，不是因為看壞美國經濟，而是認為聯準會(Fed)重啟升息後，市場已把過多緊縮預期提前反映到短端直利率。一旦通膨改善、實際升息幅度低於目前定價，兩年期殖利率回落、債價就有修復空間。兩年期美債對Fed政策最敏感，自今年2月低點以來殖利率已上揚約140個基點。
Fed上周三(16日)決議升息1碼至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，12名FOMC委員全票通過，會後兩年期美債殖利率衝上約4.75%，創多年新高，期貨與利率交換市場計入未來一年再緊縮約數10個至80個基點，部分曲線定價甚至指向明年9月政策利率約4.68%。
WisdomTree投資策略主管Kevin Flanagan指出，兩年期美債殖利率明顯高於當前政策利率，代表短端可能「走得太遠」。若要在殖利率曲線上找過度調整的位置，短端最突出。這也是近期資金回流兩年債的核心：假設Fed終能壓低通膨，當前4.75%附近收益率可視為安全墊，即使後續仍升息，只要路徑沒有市場目前計價那麼鷹，債價就有資本利得。
另據《彭博資訊》報導，與擔保隔夜融資利率(SOFR)連動、可在利率下行獲利的選擇權買盤增加。SOFR與Fed政策預期高度相關，顯示部分資金押緊縮預期過度。
Allspring Global Investments固定收益首席策略師George Bory表示，在Fed主席華許於傑克森霍爾央行年會上強調重建物價穩定後已加碼債券，並把久期適度向中期延伸，因中短債對長期通膨、財政與期限溢價敏感度較低，但票面收益已處近年高位。
Barings多資產組合解決方案主管Trevor Slaven也說，當前短端直利率是「最易形成明確價值判斷」的區域。他以約4.75%兩年期殖利率對比交換市場所隱含2027年9月約4.68%政策利率，認為市場已計入額外三次升息，實際發生機率不高。對持有到期者，4.75%票息本身就是回報；對主動操作者，若通膨或終點利率低於預期，還有價差可賺。
然而，這筆交易不是無險。中東與俄烏情勢持續，能源價格若再飆，恐把整體通膨與收支預期推高，逼Fed升息升得比市場更猛。
美銀策略師已提醒必須防基準利率最終升至5%以上，華許在9月升息後稱此次只是移除部分「寬鬆成分」，市場解讀為貨幣政策尚未明顯扼制經濟活動。
Columbia Threadneedle投資組合經理Ed Al-Hussainy則說，最難的是判斷一年後終點利率，過往每輪升息市場都曾低估Fed最終幅度。油價便是變數，因美伊局勢緩和則原油回跌、通膨預期降，而中東供應中斷擴大，則能源再成推升利率的力量。
Fed最新點陣圖的中位數傾向今年再升一次、2027年維穩，但官員公開路徑仍落後於市場定價；兩年期美債殖利率已跑在聯邦基金區間上方，讓短債同時具「高票息」與「政策錯價回補」兩種屬性。這也解釋周二(22日)690億美元兩年債拍賣為何受矚，因為承銷利率與投標倍數若表現穩健，代表短端「過度升息定價」獲更多資金認可；若得標殖利率再上、需求偏軟，則說明市場仍相信華許會把抗通膨做到通膨趨勢明確回2%為止。
整體看，短端美債正出現罕見窗口：殖利率因激進緊縮預期大漲，卻吸引看好通膨受控、實際升息低於定價的資金。周二拍賣結果、SOFR選擇權與兩年期走勢，將成為未來數周觀察「市場是否過度鷹派」的最直接三個標的。
paras_en: U.S. short‑term Treasury bonds have recently experienced a wave of “contrarian buying back,” as investors increase exposure to two‑year Treasuries—not because they are pessimistic about the U.S. economy, but because they believe that after the Fed resumes rate hikes the market has already priced too much tightening into short‑end yields. If inflation eases and the actual rate‑hike magnitude ends up lower than current pricing, the two‑year yield should fall and bond prices have room to recover. The two‑year note is the most Fed‑sensitive segment, having risen about 140 basis points since its low in February this year.

The Fed on Wednesday (the 16th) voted to raise rates by one quarter‑point to a target range of 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023, with all 12 FOMC members voting in favor. After the decision, the two‑year Treasury yield spiked to roughly 4.75%, a multi‑year high, while futures and interest‑rate swap markets priced an additional 10‑80 basis points of tightening over the next year, and some curve pricing even implied a policy rate of about 4.68% by September 2025.

Kevin Flanagan, head of investment strategy at WisdomTree, noted that the two‑year yield is clearly above the current policy rate, suggesting the short end may have “run too far.” If one looks for an over‑adjusted spot on the yield curve, the short end stands out. This is the core reason for the recent flow back into two‑year bonds: assuming the Fed can eventually bring inflation down, the current ~4.75% yield can be seen as a safe cushion, and even if rates rise further, as long as the path isn’t as hawkish as the market currently prices, bond prices can generate capital gains.

Bloomberg reports that buying pressure on options linked to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR)—which profit from a decline in rates—has increased. SOFR is highly correlated with Fed policy expectations, indicating that some investors are over‑betting on tightening.

George Bory, chief fixed‑income strategist at Allspring Global Investments, said that after Fed Chair Waller emphasized rebuilding price stability at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium, he has added to bonds and modestly extended duration toward the medium term, because intermediate‑term debt is less sensitive to long‑term inflation, fiscal concerns, and term premia, while its coupon is already near multi‑year highs.

Trevor Slaven, head of multi‑asset solutions at Barings, added that the current short‑end yield is the “area where a clear value judgement is easiest.” Comparing the roughly 4.75% two‑year yield with the implied policy rate of about 4.68% for September 2027 from the swap market, he believes the market has priced in three additional hikes that are unlikely to materialize. For hold‑to‑maturity investors, the 4.75% coupon itself is the return; for active traders, there is still price spread to capture if inflation or the terminal rate ends up lower than expected.

However, the trade is not risk‑free. Ongoing tensions in the Middle East and the Russia‑Ukraine war could push energy prices higher again, raising overall inflation and balance‑sheet expectations and forcing the Fed to hike more aggressively than the market anticipates.

Bank of America strategists have warned that the benchmark rate could ultimately rise above 5%. After Waller’s September hike, he described the move as merely stripping away part of the “accommodative component,” which markets read as monetary policy still not strongly curbing economic activity.

Ed Al‑Hussainy, portfolio manager at Columbia Threadneedle, said the hardest part is forecasting the terminal rate a year out, noting that past tightening cycles have often seen the market underestimate the Fed’s final stance. Oil prices remain a wildcard: a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions could pull crude lower and ease inflation expectations, while a widening supply disruption in the Middle East could push energy‑driven rate pressures higher again.

The latest Fed dot‑plot median leans toward one more hike this year and a steady rate through 2027, but officials’ public guidance still lags market pricing. The two‑year yield now sits above the fed‑funds target range, giving short‑term debt both a “high coupon” and a “policy mis‑pricing correction” characteristic. This explains why the $69 billion two‑year auction on Tuesday the 22nd attracted attention: a solid underwriting rate and bid‑to‑cover ratio would signal that the market acknowledges the “over‑priced aggressive hike” on the short end, while a higher winning yield and soft demand would suggest investors still believe Waller will keep fighting inflation until the trend clearly returns to 2%.

Overall, the short‑end Treasury market is presenting a rare window: yields have surged on aggressive tightening expectations, yet they are drawing capital that believes inflation will be contained and that actual rate hikes will be lower than priced. The outcome of Tuesday’s auction, SOFR option activity, and the two‑year trend will be the three most direct gauges over the coming weeks of whether the market is being overly hawkish.

items.title: 中國爆款App「死了麼」改名復活 獲千萬融資、搶攻3億銀髮族商機
paras: 中國爆紅的App「死了麼」 曇花現世，如今改頭換面重返市場，不僅換上較親民的名字、獲得創投融資，更進軍龐大的中國高齡人口商機。
該應用程式於今年1月迅速竄紅，直面中國日益增加的獨居人口所面臨的難題：萬一自己遭遇不測，要過多久才會被外人發現？
它提供的解決方案相當簡單。使用者須定期報平安，若連續多次未完成簽到，應用程式便會通知緊急聯絡人。
帶有黑色幽默的中文名「死了麼」，也助其登上蘋果付費應用程式排行榜榜首，但短短幾天後，該程式便突然從中國應用程式商店下架。
4個月後，「死了麼」以「在麼在麼」之名重新上架，大致可理解為「在嗎？在嗎？」不過，更大的轉變在於其鎖定的使用族群。
該公司目前正與杭州官方合作，針對獨居長者提供相關服務。新版本能將日常智慧型手機的使用情況登記為打卡機制，當長者未如期打卡時，便會向家屬或社區工作人員發出警報，並提供一鍵求助功能。
對當地居民而言，它所解決的痛點十分明確。
杭州市南星街道居民范美麗表示：「我和丈夫年紀都大了，他已經90歲，行動也不方便。我們的孩子不在身邊。我最怕的不是生病，而是跌倒或發生意外卻沒人知道。」
截至 2025 年底，中國 60 歲及以上人口超過 3.23 億人，占總人口的 23%。
這款應用程式的開發團隊正試圖將這項人口結構趨勢轉化為商機。創辦人呂功琛表示，公司今年4月完成一輪融資，以約10%股權募得約人民幣1,000萬元，約合140萬美元。
今年6月，公司又表示正尋求以5%股權籌資人民幣1,000萬元，意味其估值約達人民幣2億元。
該公司提出的基本養老服務方案，每人每年費用約人民幣20元，並希望擴大由政府支持的社區服務模式。
此一構想契合中國為因應人口急遽老化而推動的科技應用浪潮。清華大學五道口金融學院中國保險與養老金研究中心主任魏晨陽表示，在社區與居家養老服務中導入數位科技已「勢在必行」，且擁有「廣闊的發展空間」。
這與當初三位年輕開發者為擔憂獨居猝死族群打造惡趣味App的初衷，已不可同日而語。
「死了麼」或許一度只是網路上的爆紅話題，但它無意間觸及的社會痛點，最終可能演變成一門龐大生意。

items.title: 美國柴油零售價首度突破6.5美元 期中選舉前夕加劇通膨壓力
items.title_en: U.S. Diesel Retail Price Breaks $6.5 per Gallon for the First Time, Heightening Inflation Pressure Ahead of Midterm Elections
paras: 根據美國汽車協會(AAA)最新數據，美國全國柴油平均零售價格已升至每加侖6.505美元，創下歷史新高。自美伊衝突爆發以來，柴油價格已暴漲約70%，單在9月份就大幅上漲超過87美分，一舉打破2022年俄烏戰爭初期創下的每加侖5.81美元高點。
儘管經通膨調整後實質價格仍略低於2022年峰值，但高漲的能源成本已對運輸、農業及家庭供暖造成沉重的費用負擔。
柴油供應吃緊主要受到雙重打擊。首先，美伊戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽的航運受阻，原油與成品油運輸受限，全球煉油廠產能無法全面恢復。其次，烏克蘭無人機襲擊俄羅斯煉油廠後，俄國當局實施柴油出口禁令並可能延長至10月，進一步加劇全球燃料供應緊張。
隨著美國期中選舉臨近，柴油暴漲恐削弱川普政府與共和黨在農業大州愛荷華州，以及依賴供暖油的緬因州之選民支持。
市場傳出白宮或將實施柴油出口限制以平抑國內油價，但國家能源主導委員會主席、內政部長伯古姆(Doug Burgum)坦言，禁令未必能有效降價。此外，頑固的通膨壓力已促使聯準會上周升息1碼(0.25個百分點)，是自2023年以來首次升息。
高盛警告，在全球供應持續受限下，柴油價格仍有進一步推升的空間。
paras_en: According to the latest data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), the average retail price of diesel nationwide has risen to $6.505 per gallon, a historic high. Since the outbreak of the U.S.-Iran conflict, diesel prices have surged about 70%, and in September alone they jumped more than 87 cents, shattering the $5.81 per‑gallon peak set early in the 2022 Russia‑Ukraine war.

Even after adjusting for inflation, the real price remains slightly below the 2022 peak, but the soaring energy costs are imposing a heavy financial burden on transportation, agriculture and household heating.

Diesel supply is tightening due to a double blow. First, the U.S.-Iran war has disrupted shipping through the Hormuz Strait, limiting the transport of crude oil and refined products and preventing global refineries from fully restoring capacity. Second, after Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries, Russian authorities imposed a diesel export ban that may be extended into October, further tightening global fuel supplies.

With the U.S. midterm elections approaching, the diesel price spike could erode support for the Trump administration and the Republican Party among voters in the agricultural heavyweight Iowa and in heating‑oil‑dependent Maine.

Reports suggest the White House may consider imposing diesel export restrictions to ease domestic fuel prices, but Doug Burgum, chair of the National Energy Advisory Committee and Secretary of the Interior, warned that a ban might not effectively lower prices. In addition, stubborn inflation pressure prompted the Federal Reserve to raise rates by one basis point (0.25 percentage point) last week, its first hike since 2023.
Goldman Sachs warned that, with global supply still constrained, diesel prices have further upside potential.

items.title: 輔助工具變執法主力？FBI局長宣稱AI使用量暴增605%   但數據遭質疑
items.title_en: Auxiliary Tools Becoming Main Enforcement Force? FBI Director Claims AI Use Surged 605% but Data Questioned
paras: 美國聯邦調查局(FBI)局長Kash Patel上周六(19日)接受《福斯新聞》專訪時表示，經由他的推動，FBI對AI技術的使用量實現了605%的成長，並稱AI「如果依法使用，就是進行資料篩選分類的關鍵工具」，對於保護兒童、防範校園槍擊案具極高價值，並列舉AI在跟進線索、阻止北卡羅來納州及「另外六個州」發生槍擊事件中的作用。
但Patel在訪談中未交代605%究竟統計了什麼，FBI幾乎沒有確鑿的公開數據說明其在多大範圍、以何種方式導入AI，「使用量」究竟指調用次數、用戶人數、項目數量還是採購規模。
可公開核驗的資料，僅能側面支撐FBI在AI「部署規模在擴張」。美國司法部2025年度AI應用項目清單顯示，歸屬FBI的AI應用案例共50項，其中9項被標記為「高影響力項目」，而該局首席AI長Katie Noyes上月曾稱，FBI獲批投入使用的AI應用案例已達139項，約為年初統計的三倍。
去年，美國聯邦總務署正式批准Claude、Gemini與ChatGPT進入政府可用產品名錄，向各政府機構開放。
今年5月，美國國防部與8家AI企業簽署合作協議。 FBI本身則在數月前發布採購文件，面向廠商徵集報價，打算斥資8800萬美元採購AI伺服器，顯示其有意進一步擴大AI業務部署。
Patel上周二(15日)在參議院聽證會上透露，他可以直接聯繫多家重量級AI企業執行長，並稱這些企業負責人均配合FBI在執法事務上的協作訴求。他同時提出，能夠存取廠商的大模型，有助於打擊借助AI實施的犯罪，犯罪集團已利用模型蒸餾攻擊手段自行搭建專用AI模型。FBI現已設定專門分類標籤，用於統計各類與AI相關的犯罪，在最新網路犯罪報告中，投資詐騙、婚戀騙局與虛假求職詐騙被列為AI犯罪的熱點領域。
在實際操作上，Patel今年5月曾在專欄刊文指出，借助人臉識別等AI工具，失蹤兒童尋回數量提升30%，虐童案件逮捕人數上升20%，FBI也已啟用AI工具完成通話錄音轉寫、生成內容精簡摘要，並輔助梳理人員聯絡關係、關聯其他報案線索。
他特別提到，分析師團隊以往處理憑搜索令調取到的海量通訊資訊往往要耗費數週，而AI可以顯著壓縮這一時間。
Patel列舉的多項成效來自FBI內部工具與數據，外界無法重複驗證，605%的增幅因此更像是一句政治傳播意義上的業績宣示，而非可審計的量化結論。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Director Kash Patel told Fox News in an interview last Saturday (the 19th) that, thanks to his push, the FBI’s use of AI technology has grown 605%, calling AI “a key tool for data filtering and classification when used lawfully” and saying it is extremely valuable for protecting children and preventing school shootings, citing AI’s role in following leads and averting shootings in North Carolina and “six other states.”

However, Patel did not explain what the 605% actually measures; the FBI has virtually no public data showing the scope or manner of its AI adoption, and it is unclear whether “usage” refers to call volume, number of users, number of projects, or procurement size.

The only publicly verifiable information merely supports the notion that the FBI’s AI “deployment scale is expanding.” The Department of Justice’s 2025 AI application project list shows 50 AI use cases attributed to the FBI, nine of which are flagged as “high‑impact projects,” and the agency’s chief AI officer Katie Noyes said last month that the FBI now has 139 approved AI applications, roughly three times the count at the start of the year.

Last year the U.S. General Services Administration formally approved Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT for inclusion in the government‑approved product catalog, making them available to all federal agencies.

In May of this year the Department of Defense signed cooperation agreements with eight AI firms. The FBI itself released a procurement solicitation a few months ago, seeking vendor quotes for $88 million in AI servers, indicating its intent to further expand AI deployments.

Patel told a Senate hearing on Tuesday (the 15th) that he can directly contact the CEOs of several heavyweight AI companies, and that these leaders are cooperating with the FBI’s law‑enforcement needs. He added that access to vendors’ large models helps combat crimes that leverage AI, noting that criminal groups have used model‑distillation attacks to build custom AI models. The FBI has now created specific classification tags to track AI‑related crimes, and its latest internet‑crime report lists investment fraud, romance scams and fake job scams as hot AI‑crime domains.

In practice, Patel wrote in a May column that using AI tools such as facial‑recognition has increased the recovery rate of missing children by 30% and boosted arrests in child‑abuse cases by 20%. The FBI also uses AI to transcribe phone calls, generate concise summaries, and assist in mapping personnel contacts and linking other reports.
He specifically noted that analysts previously spent weeks sifting through massive volumes of communications obtained via search warrants, whereas AI can dramatically compress that time.

The many successes Patel cites come from internal FBI tools and data that outsiders cannot independently verify, making the 605% jump appear more like a political talking point than an auditable quantitative conclusion.

items.title: 川普大改美版凱旋門設計 屋頂擬部署無人機、狙擊手
items.title_en: Trump Overhauls US Arc de Triomphe Design, Plans to Deploy Drones and Snipers on Roof
paras: 美國總統川普大幅修改華盛頓凱旋門設計方案，計畫把這座原本定位為紀念地標的建築，改造成兼具軍事用途的綜合設施，不僅可儲存軍事裝備，還能在屋頂及廣場區域部署無人機與狙擊手。
川普上週日(20日)在社群平台發文表示，應美國軍方強烈要求，並基於國家安全考量，他提議讓規劃中的凱旋門兼作軍事裝備儲存中心，具備容納、存放及迅速運用大量無人機與狙擊手的能力。
依照川普說法，無人機與狙擊手將部署在凱旋門屋頂和廣場區域，設施內也會存放大量狙擊手彈藥。不過，他並未進一步說明軍事設施的具體配置，也沒有提供相關施工計畫或時程細節。
川普聲稱，全球不會有其他類似設施。他並表示，在59個頂級城市和首都之中，華盛頓特區是全球唯一沒有凱旋門的城市，但未具體列出所指的城市與首都。
川普今年4月首度提出在美國首都興建凱旋門。稍早公布的設計效果圖顯示，拱門頂端將矗立一尊金色自由女神像，兩側各設置一隻金鷹；拱門兩側則分別鐫刻「上帝之下的一個國家」及「人人享有自由與正義」的金色字樣。從基座至金色自由女神像頂端，整座拱門高度預計達76公尺。
華盛頓凱旋門預計本月動工，但計畫此前已因設計方案及施工期間可能引發的交通壅塞問題，掀起巨大爭議。根據美國國家公園管理局6月發布的評估報告，工程原先估計需時兩到三年，施工人員每天分成兩班，每班工作10小時。
建築高度同樣引發飛安疑慮，外界一度認為，76公尺高的拱門可能對華盛頓雷根國家機場航班構成危險。不過，美國聯邦航空管理局上週五認定，這座規劃中的拱門不會對飛航安全造成威脅。
凱旋門是川普第二任期內親自推動的多項華盛頓翻新及建設工程之一。這些計畫未獲美國社會普遍支持，反而引發不少不滿。川普政府為相關工程提出的理由，多與國家安全有關。
例如，川普政府先前向最高法院主張，白宮宴會廳屬於綜合軍事設施的一部分，若工程延誤將損害國家安全。
如今，原本具有象徵與紀念性質的凱旋門也被納入軍事構想，從首都地標進一步轉變為可部署無人機、狙擊手及儲存彈藥的軍事複合設施。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump has dramatically altered the design plan for Washington’s Arc de Triomphe, proposing to turn the landmark, originally intended as a commemorative monument, into a multifunctional facility with military uses that can store equipment and host drones and snipers on its roof and plaza.

Trump posted on social media last Sunday (the 20th) that, at the strong request of the U.S. military and for national‑security reasons, he is proposing the planned Arc to also serve as a storage hub for military gear, capable of housing, storing and rapidly deploying large numbers of drones and snipers.

According to Trump, drones and snipers would be positioned on the Arc’s roof and plaza, and the facility would also hold a substantial cache of sniper ammunition, though he gave no details on the specific military layout or any construction schedule.

Trump claimed no other similar facility exists worldwide and noted that among 59 major cities and capitals, Washington, D.C., is the only one without an Arc de Triomphe, without naming the other cities or capitals he was referring to.

Trump first floated the idea of building an Arc in the nation’s capital in April. Earlier renderings showed a golden Statue of Liberty atop the arch, flanked by a golden eagle on each side, with the phrases “A nation under God” and “Freedom and justice for all” engraved in gold on the sides, and the total height from base to the statue’s peak projected at 76 metres.

The Washington Arc is slated to break ground this month, but the project has already sparked fierce controversy over potential traffic congestion during construction. A June assessment by the National Park Service estimated the work would take two to three years, with crews working two shifts a day, each shift ten hours long.

The height also raised aviation‑safety concerns, as some feared a 76‑metre structure could endanger flights at nearby Reagan National Airport. However, the Federal Aviation Administration ruled last Friday that the proposed arch would not pose a threat to flight safety.

The Arc is one of several Washington renovation and construction projects personally championed by Trump during his second term, many of which have lacked broad public support and provoked discontent, with the administration often citing national‑security justifications.

For example, the Trump administration previously argued before the Supreme Court that the White House’s State Dining Room should be considered part of a combined military facility, claiming that delays to the project would jeopardize national security.

Now, the originally symbolic and commemorative Arc de Triomphe has been folded into a military concept, shifting from a capital‑city landmark to a complex that could host drones, snipers and store ammunition.

items.title: 全球AI浪潮強勁推升 南韓9月前20日出口額創歷史新高
items.title_en: Global AI Wave Strongly Boosts South Korea's Early September Export Value to a Historic High
paras: 在全球人工智慧(AI)半導體需求的強勁支撐下，南韓9月上旬出口表現亮眼，刷新歷年同期紀錄。
根據南韓關稅廳發布的最新數據，9月前20日經過工作日天數調整後的出口額較去年同期大幅成長89.8%，顯著優於8月同期的61.5%增幅。在未調整基礎下，出口年增78.3%，進口成長26.7%，使貿易順差達近230億美元，出口總額則攀升至714億美元的歷史新高。
從產品結構來看，半導體(晶片)依然是出口成長的核心引擎，出口額年增259.4%至341億美元的新高。石油產品與汽車出口則分別成長47.8%及9.3%。
主要市場方面，對中國與美國出口強勁，分別成長113.8%與118%；對越南與歐盟出口各成長44.8%及37%，顯示第三季末貿易動能依然十分充沛。
強勁的出口熱潮也鞏固了南韓中央銀行對經濟韌性的信心，認為現有經濟實力足以承受較高借貸成本。
面對優於預期的成長與潛在通膨壓力，南韓央行於8月升息1碼(0.25個百分點)至3%，此為連續第二次升息，並將2026年經濟成長率預估值由2.6%上調至3.3%。對於未來的利率走向，六個月期利率預估中位數落在3.25%，隱含可能再升息1碼。
對此，南韓央行總裁申鉉松(Shin Hyun Song)指出，在連續兩次調升利率後，該數據顯示未來緊縮政策將採取溫和且漸進的步調進行。
paras_en: Supported by robust global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductors, South Korea's export performance in early September was impressive, setting a new record for the same period in history.

According to the latest data released by South Korea's Customs Service, after adjusting for working days, export value for the first 20 days of September surged 89.8% year‑on‑year, far outpacing August's 61.5% increase. On a non‑adjusted basis, exports grew 78.3% year‑on‑year, imports rose 26.7%, resulting in a trade surplus of nearly $23 billion and pushing total exports to a historic high of $71.4 billion.

In terms of product composition, semiconductors (chips) remain the core engine of export growth, with export value jumping 259.4% year‑on‑year to a new high of $34.1 billion. Petroleum products and automobiles also posted gains of 47.8% and 9.3% respectively.

On the market side, exports to China and the United States were especially strong, rising 113.8% and 118% respectively, while shipments to Vietnam and the EU grew 44.8% and 37%, indicating that trade momentum remained robust at the end of the third quarter.
The vigorous export surge also reinforced the Bank of Korea's confidence in the economy's resilience, affirming that existing economic strength is sufficient to absorb higher borrowing costs.

Facing better‑than‑expected growth and potential inflationary pressures, the Bank of Korea raised its policy rate by one basis point (0.25 percentage point) to 3% in August, marking the second consecutive hike, and upgraded its 2026 growth forecast from 2.6% to 3.3%. The median estimate for the six‑month rate now sits at 3.25%, implying a possible further one‑point increase.
Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun‑Song said that after two successive rate hikes, the data suggest future tightening will proceed in a moderate and gradual manner.

items.title: 全球油輪荒來了！ 全球超級油輪運力告急　日租金破百萬美元創史高　一桶油光運費就要26美元
items.title_en: Global Oil Tanker Shortage Arrives! Super‑Tanker Capacity in Crisis, Daily Hire Breaks $1 Million Record, Freight Hits $26 per Barrel
paras: 國際原油價格在今(21)日亞洲早盤交易時段呈現連四日跌勢，恐創6月以來最長下跌紀錄，布蘭特原油跌至每桶101美元附近，WTI原油期貨跌破每桶98美元，但縱使如此，全球能源市場正面臨一個新的供應瓶頸，也就是能將原油運往煉廠的油輪出現嚴重短缺。
受美伊戰爭持續、荷姆茲海峽航運受限，以及沙烏地阿拉伯輸油管線遇襲等因素影響，全球超大型油輪(VLCC)運力迅速吃緊，部分關鍵航線日租金一度突破100萬美元，創下歷史新高紀錄。
不斷攀升的海運成本正成為原油以外另一項重要支出。即使國際油價從近期高點回落，煉廠取得原油的實際到岸成本仍可能居高不下，進而拖慢汽油、柴油等燃料價格的下降速度。
目前壓力最明顯的是可裝載約200萬桶原油的VLCC。根據《華爾街日報》引述航運情報公司Windward數據，本月從波斯灣裝貨並穿越荷姆茲海峽的租金曾超過每天100萬美元。以部分航次計算，運費相當於每桶約26美元，在目前每桶約100美元的原油價格中佔比達到約四分之一。正常情況下，原油運輸成本僅佔貨值很小一部分。
油輪緊張已擴散至中東以外。Clarksons Research數據顯示，截至上周四(17日)，全球VLCC平均日收益升至約65.1萬美元，一週接近翻倍。西非至亞洲等不需進入荷姆茲海峽的航線也同步漲價，凸顯問題已從單一區域的「戰爭風險溢價」演變成全球可用船舶不足。
這一波油輪短缺近期突然惡化，與沙國輸油管線遭襲直接相關。該管線連接沙國東部油田與紅海港口延布，是沙國繞過荷姆茲海峽最重要的出口通道。近日，葉門胡塞武裝攻擊導致多個泵站受損後，延佈原油裝船一度中斷，沙國不得不重新調整物流，將更多原油從波斯灣的拉斯坦努拉港運出，經荷姆茲海峽後，在阿曼蘇哈爾附近進行船對船轉運。
貿易人士表示，沙國已安排9月和10月約6000萬桶原油採用此模式，平均每日100萬至150萬桶，這解決了「有沒有油」的問題，卻加重了「有沒有船」的問題。原本一艘VLCC裝貨後可直接駛往亞洲，現在部分船舶需承擔波斯灣至阿曼的短途穿梭，再由另一艘船接貨駛往目的地，同樣一批原油需佔用更多船舶和航行時間。目前，全球約900艘VLCC中約有15%聚集在阿曼附近海域。
另一端的紅海同樣在消耗油輪運力。胡塞武裝近期擴大在葉門紅海沿岸控制，並持續攻擊沙國相關船隻。沙國船舶減少通過曼德海峽，部分選擇繞過南非好望角，航程增加約兩週。
根據Windward估算，一艘船繞行好望角額外成本約100萬美元，且船舶多花兩週就意味著市場少了一艘可重新裝貨的油輪，有效運力進一步下降。
對煉油廠而言，真正關心的是原油抵達煉廠時的「到岸成本」，包括原油價格、運輸、保險、戰爭風險費用等。若原油從108美元跌到103美元，但運輸成本增加10美元甚至20美元，煉廠實際成本並不會同步下降。高額運費也會壓縮煉油利潤，煉廠可能減少遠距離原油採購，或將物流成本轉嫁到汽油、柴油和航空燃油售價，這可能導致一種看似反常的局面：原油期貨回落，終端燃料價格卻維持高位。
目前，中東和俄國煉油廠受襲，加上部分出口國減少供應，柴油和航空燃油市場本身偏緊。歐洲今年Q4預計面臨每日51萬桶的航空燃油缺口，需從美國、加拿大、韓國等更遠市場補充，進一步增加遠距離海運需求。市場正同時爭取運原油和運成品油的兩種運輸能力。
沙國現正搶修東西輸油管，部分運能可能在數天內恢復。若延布重新裝船，沙國對荷姆茲和阿曼船對船轉運的依賴將會下降，這也成為上週油價回落的重要原因。
但運價能否同步快速恢復正常仍不確定。大量船舶已改變航線，紅海安全風險也未消失，即便管線逐步恢復，船舶需完成現有航次才能回到傳統線路，油輪供需重新平衡存在時間差。
未來汽油和柴油價格的關鍵變數已不再只有布蘭特原油。油輪日租金、荷姆茲航運量、曼德海峽安全狀況及沙國管線恢復速度，正共同決定一桶原油真正送到煉廠的成本。只要大量油輪繼續被困在更長、更複雜的運輸鏈條上，原油價格下跌的好處，就可能有相當一部分被高昂運費抵消。
paras_en: International crude oil prices fell for the fourth consecutive day during today’s (21st) Asian morning session, potentially setting the longest decline since June. Brent slipped to around $101 a barrel and WTI futures fell below $98, yet despite the price drop the global energy market faces a new supply bottleneck: a severe shortage of tankers to ship crude to refineries.

The ongoing US‑Iran conflict, restrictions in the Hormuz Strait, and attacks on Saudi Arabia’s oil pipelines have tightened capacity for ultra‑large crude carriers (VLCCs). On some key routes, daily hire rates have briefly surged past $1 million, a historic high.

Rising maritime costs are becoming a major expense beyond the crude itself. Even as oil prices retreat from recent peaks, the landed cost for refineries may stay high, slowing the decline of gasoline, diesel and other fuel prices.

The pressure is most evident for VLCCs that can carry about 2 million barrels. According to the Wall Street Journal citing shipping intelligence firm Windward, this month hires for loading in the Persian Gulf and transiting the Hormuz Strait exceeded $1 million per day. For some voyages the freight works out to roughly $26 per barrel, about a quarter of a $100‑a‑barrel crude price, whereas normally transport costs are a tiny fraction of cargo value.

The tanker crunch has spread beyond the Middle East. Clarksons Research data show that as of last Thursday (the 17th) the average daily earnings for VLCCs worldwide rose to about $651,000, nearly doubling in a week. Routes that avoid Hormuz, such as West Africa to Asia, have also seen price hikes, indicating the issue has shifted from a regional “war‑risk premium” to a global shortage of available vessels.

This latest wave of tanker scarcity worsened suddenly due to attacks on Saudi pipelines. The line linking Saudi eastern fields to the Red Sea port of Yanbu is the kingdom’s most important export route that bypasses Hormuz. Recent Houthi strikes damaged several pump stations, halting loading at Yanbu and forcing Saudi Arabia to reroute more crude from the Persian Gulf’s Ras Tanura port through Hormuz and then conduct ship‑to‑ship transfers near Suhar, Oman.

Traders say Saudi Arabia has scheduled about 60 million barrels for this ship‑to‑ship mode in September and October, averaging 1‑1.5 million barrels per day. This solves the “is there oil?” problem but aggravates the “are there enough ships?” issue. A VLCC that once could sail straight to Asia now often has to make a short hop from the Gulf to Oman before another vessel takes over, meaning the same cargo occupies more ships and more sailing time. Roughly 15 % of the world’s ~900 VLCCs are currently clustered near Omani waters.

The Red Sea side is also draining tanker capacity. Houthi forces have expanded control along Yemen’s Red Sea coast and continue to attack Saudi‑linked vessels. Saudi ships are cutting back on transits through the Bab el‑Mandeb, with some opting to round South Africa’s Cape of Good Hope, adding about two weeks to the voyage.

Windward estimates that a Cape‑of‑Good‑Hope detour adds roughly $1 million in extra cost per vessel, and the additional two‑week sailing time means one fewer tanker is available to reload, further reducing effective capacity.

For refiners, the key metric is the “landed cost” of crude – the sum of the oil price, freight, insurance and war‑risk fees. If crude falls from $108 to $103 but freight rises by $10‑$20 per barrel, the actual cost to the refinery does not drop proportionally. High freight squeezes refining margins, prompting refiners to cut long‑haul crude purchases or pass logistics costs onto gasoline, diesel and jet‑fuel prices, creating a paradox where falling crude futures coexist with stubbornly high end‑product prices.

Currently, Middle‑East and Russian refineries are under attack and some exporters have cut supply, tightening diesel and jet‑fuel markets. Europe is projected to face a 510,000‑barrel‑per‑day jet‑fuel shortfall in Q4, requiring imports from the United States, Canada, South Korea and other distant markets, which further boosts long‑distance shipping demand. The market is simultaneously vying for capacity to move both crude and refined products.

Saudi Arabia is hastily repairing its east‑west pipelines, and some capacity could be back in operation within days. If Yanbu resumes loading, Saudi reliance on Hormuz and Omani ship‑to‑ship transfers will fall, which helped push oil prices down last week.

However, it remains uncertain whether freight rates will rebound quickly. Many vessels have already altered routes and Red Sea security risks persist; even if pipelines recover, ships must finish existing voyages before returning to traditional lanes, so rebalancing tanker supply and demand will take time.

Going forward, gasoline and diesel prices will be driven by more than just Brent crude. Daily tanker hires, Hormuz traffic, Bab el‑Mandeb security and the speed of Saudi pipeline repairs will together determine the true cost of getting a barrel of oil to a refinery. As long as a large share of tankers remain stuck in longer, more complex logistics chains, the benefit of falling crude prices will be largely offset by soaring freight costs.

items.title: 伊朗撂狠話：美若重啟攻擊 所有提供援助國都將遭報復
items.title_en: Iran Issues Stern Warning: If the U.S. Resumes Attacks, All Nations Providing Assistance Will Face Retaliation
paras: 伊朗撂狠話：美若重啟攻擊 提供基地、領空國家都將遭報復
伊朗軍方周日（20日）警告，一旦美國恢復對伊朗的軍事行動，伊朗將持續打擊美國在區域內的所有基地及利益；任何向美方提供基地、領空、情報或其他軍事支援的國家，也將被視為衝突參與者，成為伊朗報復對象。
伊朗軍方表示，根據掌握的情報，美國正與部分區域國家準備恢復針對伊朗的軍事行動。伊方強調，若美國發動新一輪攻擊，其在區域內的所有基地與利益，都將面臨「持續、有效且痛苦」的打擊。
伊朗同時把警告範圍擴大至可能協助美國的區域國家。伊方表示，凡是向美國開放基地或領空，或提供情報及其他形式軍事支援者，均將被認定為參戰方，伊朗屆時不會再對這些國家保持克制。
除了美國在海灣地區的陸上基地，伊朗也將部署在印度洋方向的美國海軍力量納入潛在報復範圍，顯示伊方鎖定的目標已由區域內陸上設施，進一步延伸至周邊海域的美軍力量。
伊朗發布警告之際，美國總統川普提前結束戴維營行程返回白宮，並稱「不久的將來將發生非常重大的事情」。他將美國對伊政策概括為三種選項，包括發動更大規模軍事打擊、繼續施加經濟壓力，或與伊朗達成協議。
美國國務院隨後要求身處中東的美國公民提高警覺，並提醒區域局勢可能迅速升高。伊朗則提出，解除美國對其石油港口的封鎖、釋放遭凍結資產，以及取消石油出口制裁，是恢復談判的條件。
目前美伊雙方持續透過軍事與經濟手段相互施壓。美國試圖以軍事行動及經濟壓力迫使伊朗讓步，伊朗則以擴大報復目標回應，並把解除封鎖與制裁列為重啟談判的前提。
paras_en: Iran issued a stern warning: if the United States resumes attacks, the countries that provide bases or airspace will be retaliated against.

Iran’s armed forces warned on Sunday (the 20th) that if the United States resumes military action against Iran, Tehran will continue to strike all U.S. bases and interests in the region; any nation that supplies the U.S. with bases, airspace, intelligence or other military support will be treated as a participant in the conflict and become a target of Iranian retaliation.

The Iranian military said that, based on intelligence it has, the United States is preparing with some regional countries to resume military operations against Iran. Tehran stressed that if the U.S. launches a new round of attacks, all of its bases and interests in the region will face "continuous, effective and painful" strikes.

Iran also broadened the scope of its warning to include regional states that might assist the United States. Tehran said that any country that allows the U.S. to use its bases or airspace, or provides intelligence and other forms of military support, will be deemed a belligerent and Iran will no longer restrain itself toward those nations.

In addition to U.S. land bases in the Gulf, Iran said it would also consider U.S. naval forces operating toward the Indian Ocean as potential retaliation targets, showing that Tehran’s focus has expanded from regional land facilities to U.S. forces in nearby seas.

As Iran issued its warning, U.S. President Donald Trump cut short his trip to Camp David and returned to the White House, saying that "something very significant will happen in the near future." He summed up U.S. policy toward Iran into three options: a larger‑scale military strike, continued economic pressure, or reaching an agreement with Iran.

The U.S. State Department subsequently urged American citizens in the Middle East to stay alert and warned that the regional situation could escalate quickly. Iran, for its part, said that lifting the U.S. blockade of its oil ports, releasing frozen assets and ending oil‑export sanctions are conditions for resuming negotiations.

Both sides continue to apply pressure on each other through military and economic means. The United States is trying to force Iran to concede with military action and economic pressure, while Iran is responding by expanding its retaliation targets and making the lifting of the blockade and sanctions a prerequisite for restarting talks.

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 〈台幣〉風險情緒轉強 升值5分收31.758元
items.title_en: NTD risk sentiment turns strong, gains 0.05 and closes at 31.758
paras: 新台幣今(21)日全日維持偏強走勢，終場收在31.758元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.67億美元。
新台幣今日以31.79元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.716元，全日高低價差7.4分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元飆升超過1%，新台幣收升0.16%，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣升值0.05%上下，星元在平盤附近狹幅震盪，日元則逆勢貶近0.2%，美元指數小跌0.05%左右。
元大投顧認為，聯準會通過升息 1 碼將目標區調高至 3.75%到 4%，也是 2023 年 7 月來首次升息，但聯準會主席華許表示經濟依然強勁，可在不損害就業市場下恢復物價穩定，因此，台股在各項變數漸漸釐清後，可望展開季底作帳行情，惟個股將強弱分明。
統一投顧則指出，上周全球央行周和美日升息後，美國10年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂和繼續升息的緊張情緒，而儘管中東地緣政治局勢動盪、國際債市與匯市波動加劇、AI 放緩雜音增多，但整體風險可控，再考量美伊再次出現重啟談判曙光，可提振市場風險偏好。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar stayed on the stronger side throughout the day on the 21st, ending at NT$31.758, a gain of 0.05, with the turnover at Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanding to US$2.267 billion.
After opening at NT$31.79, up 0.018, the NTD peaked at NT$31.716, with a daily high‑low range of 0.074.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged more than 1%, the NTD rose 0.16%, the Thai baht gained over 0.1%, the Chinese yuan appreciated about 0.05%, the Singapore dollar hovered near flat, the Japanese yen fell about 0.2% against the trend, and the US dollar index slipped roughly 0.05%.

Yuanta Securities believes that the Fed’s 1‑percentage‑point rate hike, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4%, marks the first increase since July 2023. Fed Chair Jerome Powell said the economy remains strong and price stability can be restored without harming the labor market, so after variables are clarified, Taiwan’s stock market could see end‑of‑quarter accounting activity, though individual stocks will show clear winners and losers.

Unified Securities notes that after last week’s global central‑bank meetings and US‑Japan rate hikes, the US 10‑year Treasury yield stalled, easing inflation concerns and the tension over further hikes. Despite geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East, heightened volatility in international bond and FX markets, and growing noise around a slowdown in AI, overall risk remains manageable. items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.

items.title: 川習會前夕中國人行放寬升值干預 人民幣匯率創逾3年半新高
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Eases RMB Appreciation Controls Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit, RMB Hits Over 3‑Year‑Half High
paras: 在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周將舉行峰會之際，中國人民銀行放寬了對人民幣升值的限制，帶動人民幣對美元匯率於周一(21日)升至逾3年半以來的新高。
周一早盤，境內人民幣對美元一度觸及 6.6957，創下 2023 年 1 月 16 日以來的最高點；離岸人民幣升至 6.6946。
開盤前，中國人行將人民幣對美元中間價設在 6.7487，雖創下 2023 年 2 月 3 日以來的新高，但仍比《路透》調查的市場預測值弱了 536 個基點。
本次匯率走強適逢美中兩國高層密集會談。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與中國國務院副總理何立峰於周日在紐約結束會談，為川普與習近平預計於周四舉行的峰會鋪路。外界預期雙方將討論人工智慧、貿易關係、供應鏈及中東緊張局勢等議題，但分析師預估不會有重大政策突破。
針對人行近期縮小中間價與市場預期差距的舉措，高盛分析師在報告中表示，人行在川習會召開前調強中間價的作法符合近年歷史經驗，這為離岸人民幣現貨價格進一步走強創造了更大空間。
華僑銀行(OCBC)則在報告中指出，較強且相對穩定的人民幣有助於為美中談判創造更有建設性的背景，並減少美方再度指責競爭性貶值的可能性。
然而，華僑銀行也表示，不應將此視為人民幣長期升值周期的開始，並指出：「鑑於美中兩國之間龐大的利差以及中國國內依然疲軟的基本面，近期部分升值可能僅反映了峰會期間由政策維護的穩定性，而非人民幣基本面的重新估值。」
paras_en: As U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to hold a summit this week, the People’s Bank of China has loosened restrictions on RMB appreciation, pushing the RMB‑USD exchange rate up to a new high not seen in over three and a half years on Monday (the 21st).
In early trade on Monday, the onshore RMB briefly touched 6.6957 per dollar, the highest level since Jan. 16, 2023, while offshore RMB rose to 6.6946.
Before the market opened, the PBOC set the RMB‑USD midpoint at 6.7487, a fresh peak since Feb. 3, 2023, yet still 53.6 basis points weaker than the market forecast gathered by Reuters.

The currency rally comes amid intensive high‑level talks between the United States and China. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng concluded talks in New York on Sunday, paving the way for the Trump‑Xi summit slated for Thursday. Observers expect discussions on AI, trade, supply chains and Middle‑East tensions, though analysts doubt any major policy breakthroughs will emerge.

Commenting on the PBOC’s recent narrowing of the gap between the midpoint and market expectations, a Goldman Sachs analyst said that strengthening the midpoint ahead of the summit follows historical patterns and creates more room for offshore RMB spot prices to rise further.

OCBC Bank noted in its report that a stronger and relatively stable RMB helps create a more constructive backdrop for U.S.–China negotiations and reduces the likelihood of the U.S. accusing China of competitive devaluation again.

However, OCBC cautioned that this should not be seen as the start of a long‑term RMB appreciation cycle, stating: “Given the large interest‑rate differential between the United States and China and still‑weak domestic fundamentals in China, the recent modest appreciation may simply reflect policy‑backed stability during the summit period rather than a fundamental re‑valuation of the RMB.”

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Japan Raises Rates as Expected, Yen Volatility

Last Friday, Japanese official data showed that August core consumer price index (CPI) rose 1.7% year‑on‑year, while the price indicator that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) focuses on—excluding volatile fresh food and fuel prices—also rose 1.9% year‑on‑year, keeping core inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target and highlighting mounting price pressure. The BOJ, as widely expected, raised rates to a 31‑year high of 1.25% and signaled a willingness to further raise borrowing costs, joining other major central banks in tackling the sustained inflation pressure triggered by soaring oil prices. This is the first rate hike in three months, bringing rates closer to the BOJ’s perceived neutral level and marking a move away from decades of ultra‑low rates. However, the committee vote was 7‑2, with dovish members Toshihiko Asada and Ayano Sato—both nominated by Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga—opposing the hike from 1.00% to 1.25%. Their opposition suggests that future hikes may face greater resistance as the committee undergoes more turnover. Finance Minister Shigekazu Katayama said he would keep close communication with other countries’ financial authorities and emphasize a decisive, coordinated foreign‑exchange intervention, but the BOJ’s hawkish outlook fell short of expectations, weakening the yen and lifting the dollar‑yen from a low of 155.86.

After that, U.S. official data for August showed industrial production flat from the previous month and manufacturing output unexpectedly fell 0.3% month‑on‑month, underscoring the double rise in oil and rates that may outweigh the support from AI‑driven construction. The World Economic Forum’s August leading indicator also fell 0.1%, a weak reading that pressured the dollar. Meanwhile, according to Nikkei, Japanese officials conducted a currency inquiry that sparked panic about intervention, causing the dollar‑yen to fall from a high of 158.05. items.title: 風向要變了？對沖基金近一年多來首次看漲日元
items.title_en: Is the Wind Changing? Hedge Funds Turn Bullish on the Yen for the First Time in Over a Year
paras: 日本央行升息之際，對沖基金對日元的立場出現重大轉向，自2025年7月以來首次轉為淨多頭，顯示在美日兩國當局入市干預後，外匯市場情緒已明顯改變。
不過，日本央行最新政策訊號不如部分投資人預期鷹派，使剛轉向看漲日元的交易商立即面臨壓力。
根據美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）上周五(18日)公布的數據，截至9月15日當周，槓桿交易商已全數回補先前建立的日元空頭部位，並開始轉向做多日元。
彭博彙整數據顯示，相關基金目前持有約2,510億日元（約16億美元）的日元多頭部位。這是自2025年7月以來，對沖基金首度對日元持淨看漲立場，反映投機資金對日元後市的看法出現明顯逆轉。
這波倉位調整發生在美日當局入市干預數周後。根據彭博先前報導，美國財政部長貝森特曾表示，美方參與日元干預屬於「象徵性」行動，並表態支持美國出口競爭力。官方行動及政策訊號，成為市場重新評估日元走勢的重要因素。
日銀訊號不夠鷹派
對沖基金完成多空立場轉換的時機相當微妙。聯準會與日本央行本周相繼調高利率，但日本央行對未來政策的表態，未能滿足部分市場參與者對持續升息的預期，導致日元在升息後反而走弱，也讓剛建立多頭部位的交易商陷入被動。
日元周五盤中一度下跌1.3%，隨後跌幅收窄，紐約尾盤報約156.80日元兌1美元。根據《日經新聞》報導，日本央行已向市場參與者詢問匯率水準。此類「匯率詢價」通常被市場視為官方可能出手干預的前兆，消息傳出後，日元跌勢隨即有所緩和。
美元多頭同步降溫
與此同時，包括資產管理機構及非商業交易商在內的投機性交易人，截至9月15日已將美元淨多頭部位降至3月以來最低水準，顯示市場先前不僅提高對日元的看漲押注，也同步降低對美元的多頭布局。
然而，美元本周隨後強勢反彈，單周漲幅創下近三個月最大，使先前減持美元的交易商同樣承受壓力。日元多頭增加、美元多頭降溫，與本周實際匯率走勢形成落差，凸顯央行政策訊號仍主導短線外匯市場。
CFTC持倉數據提供市場觀察外匯交易情緒的重要窗口，反映對沖基金與資產管理機構透過衍生性金融商品建立的整體部位方向。
目前全球外匯市場日均成交規模達9.5兆美元，日元能否延續看漲氣氛，仍取決於日本央行後續升息訊號及官方是否進一步干預匯市。
paras_en: As the Bank of Japan raises rates, hedge funds have made a major shift in their yen stance, moving to a net long position for the first time since July 2025, indicating that forex market sentiment has clearly changed after interventions by U.S. and Japanese authorities.
However, the latest policy signals from the BOJ are less hawkish than some investors expected, putting immediate pressure on traders who have just turned bullish on the yen.

According to data released by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on Friday the 18th, by the week ending September 15 leveraged traders had fully covered their previously established short yen positions and begun to go long the currency.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that the relevant funds now hold about ¥251 billion (roughly $1.6 billion) of long yen positions. This is the first net‑bullish stance on the yen by hedge funds since July 2025, reflecting a clear reversal in speculative sentiment toward the currency’s outlook.

The position adjustment comes weeks after U.S. and Japanese authorities stepped into the market. Bloomberg previously reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen described the U.S. side of the yen intervention as a “symbolic” action and voiced support for U.S. export competitiveness. Official actions and policy signals have become key factors in the market’s reassessment of yen direction.
BOJ signals not hawkish enough

The timing of hedge funds’ long‑short switch is delicate. The Fed and the BOJ both raised rates this week, but the BOJ’s forward guidance failed to meet some market participants’ expectations for continued tightening, causing the yen to weaken after the rate hike and leaving newly‑long traders on the back foot.

The yen fell as much as 1.3% intraday on Friday before narrowing its loss, closing the New York session around ¥156.80 per $1. According to the Nikkei, the BOJ has queried market participants on exchange‑rate levels – a “rate inquiry” that markets usually interpret as a possible precursor to official intervention, which tempered the yen’s decline when the news broke.
Dollar bulls cool off

At the same time, speculative traders, including asset managers and non‑commercial participants, had reduced their net long dollar positions to the lowest level since March as of September 15, showing that the market not only increased its bullish bets on the yen but also scaled back its long dollar exposure.

Nevertheless, the dollar rebounded strongly later in the week, posting its biggest weekly gain in nearly three months, putting pressure on traders who had trimmed dollar exposure. The rise in yen longs and the cooling of dollar longs contrast with the week’s actual exchange‑rate moves, underscoring that central‑bank signals still dominate short‑term forex dynamics.
CFTC position data provide an important window into forex‑trading sentiment, reflecting the overall directional bias of hedge funds and asset managers through derivative instruments.

The global forex market now sees a daily turnover of about $9.5 trillion. Whether the yen can sustain its bullish momentum will still depend on the BOJ’s future rate‑hike signals and whether officials step up intervention in the currency market.

items.title: 輝達加持的AI新創Nscale申請上市！上半年營收暴增12.5倍仍虧損逾10億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Nscale Files for IPO! H1 Revenue Surges 12.5‑Fold Yet Losses Exceed $1 Billion
paras: 獲輝達(NVDA-US)投資、專注人工智慧(AI)模型基礎設施的雲端服務商Nscale，周五(18日)已向紐約證券交易所(NYSE)申請上市，股票代號為「NSCL」。
根據Nscale首次公開發行(IPO)說明書，在截至今年6月30日的六個月內期間，營收為1.406億美元，淨虧損達10.2億美元。相比之下，去年同期淨損為3.689億美元，營收僅1040萬美元，代表營收較去年同期暴增1252%。
Nscale並透露，目前為止的剩餘履約義務(RPO)達564億美元。
對手包括亞馬遜、CoreWeave
Nscale的競爭對手包括市場領先的雲端服務商亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等被稱為「新雲」(neocloud)的新一代供應商。
自2022年ChatGPT推出以來，OpenAI、Anthropic等AI實驗室對運算能力的需求似乎永無止境。因此，Anthropic與OpenAI都需要大量現金支付算力費用，兩家公司也都計劃上市。
這兩家AI實驗室都已與Nscale達成交易，由Nscale出租輝達圖形處理器(GPU)，供AI模型訓練與運行使用。
本身也是雲端服務商的微軟(MSFT-US)也已與Nscale簽約。Nscale表示，2026年上半年有一家未具名客戶貢獻超過一半營收。
尋求分散客戶、靠收購擴大AI服務
Nscale近來也試圖分散業務來源，目前已開始提供多款AI模型的推理服務。此外，7月還宣布計劃收購協助建構AI模型的新創軟體公司Anyscale。
Nscale上周宣布，曾任OpenAI、Instacart(CART-US)與Meta(META-US)高層的Fidji Simo加入董事會。其他董事會成員還包括Meta前高層Nick Clegg與桑柏格(Sheryl Sandberg)。
### 手握46.1萬顆GPU合約　但負債逾80億美元
截至8月31日，Nscale擁有2.5萬顆啟用中的GPU，若加入已啟用或已簽約的GPU，總數達46.1萬顆。公司目前擁有五座已啟用、12座已簽約的資料中心據點。
Nscale表示目前已掌握相當於10GW的運算能力，負債則超過80億美元，這個金額還沒把與AI伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)的融資計畫算進來。
Nscale總部位於倫敦，截至8月31日擁有逾1000名全職員工。該公司於2024年結束神秘模式，從加密貨幣挖礦公司Arkon Energy分拆成立，投資人包括Blue Owl、戴爾、輝達、Fidelity與Point72。
Nscale今年3月表示，在其中一輪募資中，投資人對公司的估值達146億美元。
根據Nscale向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的文件，輝達同意為Nscale在德州一項資料中心租賃協議下最高8.6億美元的義務提供擔保。
paras_en: Nscale, a cloud‑service provider focused on AI model infrastructure and backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US), filed on Friday (the 18th) for a listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker "NSCL".

According to Nscale’s prospectus, revenue for the six‑month period ending June 30 this year was $140.6 million, while net loss reached $1.02 billion. By contrast, the same period last year saw a net loss of $368.9 million and revenue of only $10.4 million, meaning revenue jumped 1,252% year‑over‑year.
Nscale disclosed that its remaining performance obligations (RPO) to date total $56.4 billion.
Competitors include Amazon and CoreWeave.
Nscale’s rivals comprise market‑leading cloud provider Amazon (AMZN‑US) as well as next‑generation “neocloud” suppliers such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US).

Since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have shown seemingly endless demand for compute power. Consequently, both Anthropic and OpenAI need massive cash to pay for compute and are planning IPOs themselves.
Both AI labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) to them for training and running AI models.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US), also a cloud provider, has signed a contract with Nscale. Nscale said an unnamed customer contributed more than half of its revenue in the first half of 2026.
Seeking to diversify its customer base and grow AI services through acquisitions

Nscale has recently been trying to diversify its revenue sources; it has begun offering inference services for a variety of AI models and announced in July a plan to acquire the AI‑model‑building startup Anyscale.

Last week Nscale announced that Fidji Simo, a former senior executive at OpenAI, Instacart (CART‑US) and Meta (META‑US), has joined its board. Other board members include former Meta executive Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.
### Holding contracts for 461,000 GPUs but debt exceeds $8 billion

As of August 31, Nscale operated 25,000 active GPUs; counting GPUs already activated or under contract brings the total to 461,000. The company currently runs five active data‑center sites and has contracts for twelve additional sites.
Nscale says it now controls roughly 10 GW of compute capacity, while its debt tops $8 billion, not including financing arrangements with AI‑server maker Dell (DELL‑US).

Nscale is headquartered in London and had more than 1,000 full‑time employees as of August 31. The company emerged from “stealth mode” in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency miner Arkon Energy, with investors such as Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72.
In March this year Nscale disclosed that a financing round valued the company at $14.6 billion.
SEC filings show that Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $860 million for Nscale’s Texas data‑center lease obligations.

items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.
